item.title: Exploratory creative pre-ranking: Hierarchical empirical-Bayes Thompson sampling for real-time creative optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Dynamic creative optimization decides which creative of an ad to render for each request.

Dynamic creative optimization decides which creative of an ad to render for each request. Recent work places that choice before ad ranking, but relies on deterministic point predictors with no calibrated uncertainty. AI-generated content has made creatives nearly free, while feedback per creative remains sparse and selection faces a tight latency budget. We introduce a creative pre-ranker that scores every recalled creative and shortlists each campaign's pool before the per-user ranker runs. Creatives sit in a hierarchy of audience segment, advertised item, campaign and creative, so a cold creative falls back on what its parent levels have earned, and how much it borrows from its parents is set in closed form from historical logs, with one parameter per level and nothing tuned. To stay within the latency budget, the pre-ranker predicts for an audience segment rather than an individual user, from per-attribute counters. It selects by a single Thompson draw per creative, balancing exploration and exploitation so that a new creative still has a chance to be learned. Replaying Roblox Sponsored-ads traffic over campaigns with competing creatives, the shortlist lifts predicted play-throu…

item.title: Efficient probabilistic weather forecasting at quarter-degree resolution with two-sided transport attention
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

High-resolution probabilistic weather forecasting remains computationally demanding.

High-resolution probabilistic weather forecasting remains computationally demanding. Here we present Astra, a 0.25$^\circ$ ensemble model trained on eight H200 GPUs. It combines Kantorovich Attention, a two-sided transport attention in which each region chooses where it reads from and writes to, so every region sends and receives at token resolution, with a self-featurised continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) that also scores forecasts in the model's multiscale features. In WeatherBench 2, Astra matches GenCast's CRPS averaged over five upper-air targets and days 1-10 with 9.8% of its hardware-normalised training compute. Verified against ERA5, its CRPS and ensemble-mean root-mean-square error are lower than the ECMWF ensemble's on all 600 variable, level and lead-time combinations, and its CRPS is lower than GenCast's on 73.5% of them. A 15-day member needs 39 times fewer floating-point operations than GenCast's GPU implementation, and 50 members take under 40 min on one consumer GPU, within 21 GB.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Efficient Exact Unlearning for Federated Zeroth-Order Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Federated zeroth-order optimization (FedZOO) reduces the memory and communication costs of collaborative training for edge intelligence by avoiding backpropa...

Federated zeroth-order optimization (FedZOO) reduces the memory and communication costs of collaborative training for edge intelligence by avoiding backpropagation while communicating only random seeds and scalar coefficients. However, existing methods lack efficient mechanisms for exact unlearning to fully remove the influence of training data when users request deletion. A key insight is that total variation stability of the learning algorithm creates overlap between model distributions before and after data deletion, allowing exact unlearning to reuse computation through coupling. Based on this observation, we jointly design two stable zeroth-order learning algorithms and their corresponding exact-unlearning procedures: \textsc{FedZOO-S} obtains stability through client and mini-batch subsampling, enabling \textsc{FedZOUL-S} to perform efficient unlearning by preserving earlier updates and restarting from the first affected step. \textsc{FedZOO-NS} further combines subsampling with Gaussian noise to increase overlap between update distributions; \textsc{FedZOUL-NS} exploits this overlap through rejection--reflection coupling to reuse affected updates when the coupling is accepte…

item.description:

研究问题 MoE 的稀疏专家执行并不消除适配时需存储的中间状态——如何在有限显存下高效适配 MoE 大模型？

方法 DuplexTune：经预训练 attention 与专家模块重放耦合隐藏状态，可训练宽度桥连接两条残差流；桥预热先于主干适配，路由器权重冻结；分析隐式状态恢复方程给出重建的收敛与重放条件。

关键数字 Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B 单 H800：峰值内存 38.8GB（SFT+checkpointing 为 64.8GB），吞吐 25.1 vs 19.9 samples/s；MMLU 67.2%、GSM8K 75.6%、MT-Bench 7.69，多语言分低于基线。

为什么值得看 把 MoE 适配的内存瓶颈量化清楚，展示状态存储-吞吐-质量的三角权衡。

item.title: Distilling neural networks into equations to predict planetary instability
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

The problem of predicting when a multi-planet system will become dynamically unstable has defied analytical progress over the past three hundred years.

The problem of predicting when a multi-planet system will become dynamically unstable has defied analytical progress over the past three hundred years. Recent machine learning advances achieve high predictive performance of instability dynamics, but as black-box systems cannot be interpreted to connect to existing scientific understanding. Here we show analytic equations that predict when a multi-planet system will undergo instability. We discover these equations by first training a neural network on a dataset of N-body simulations, and then distilling its latent knowledge into closed-form algebraic expressions. Our two-stage pipeline first learns an interpretable variable basis, then searches for equations using symbolic regression. The resulting equations outperform existing analytic estimates of instability and apply across wide ranges of mass ratios, spacing, and orbital eccentricities. They capture structure in the prediction landscape with a small number of variables amenable to dynamical interpretation. These results demonstrate how symbolic learning can be combined with neural networks to extract scientific insight from complex dynamical systems.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Detection of Single Stuck-at and Bridging Faults in Cluster-based FPGA Architectures
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

This paper presents a new technique for detecting single stuck-at and bridging faults in cluster-based FPGA architectures, using same set of test vectors gen...

This paper presents a new technique for detecting single stuck-at and bridging faults in cluster-based FPGA architectures, using same set of test vectors generated by a test pattern generator circuitry. This technique is based on configuration of logic elements using test logic structure and the outputs of two separated logic elements are compared to detect a fault. To do this, block under test, TPG and output response analysis circuitry are generated in FPGAs. The configurations of test pattern generation, block under test and output response analysis are also discussed in this paper. The novelty lies in the fact that the same set of test vectors can detect all the stuck-at as well as bridging faults if the test vectors are applied in a particular sequence and analyzing the output results. We presented a detail analysis of results to detect faults as well.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Correlation-Aware Exploration for Long-Trace Reasoning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Reasoning models trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) now produce chains of thought thousands of tokens long, and recent studies reveal tha...

Reasoning models trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) now produce chains of thought thousands of tokens long, and recent studies reveal that such training is prone to policy collapse. Entropy regularization is the standard remedy, but it works by pushing probability mass away from the few tokens that carry it and toward the vast low-probability tail of the vocabulary, and it applies this force once for every token of the reasoning trace. This puts the bonus in direct conflict with the entropy decay that convergence requires, and makes its coefficient difficult to set in the long-trace regime. Rather than raising entropy everywhere, Info-GRPO builds on the mutual information between a latent variable and the trajectory it induces: augmenting prompts with latent seeds during training lets the model explore diverse policies correlated with the prior, while the seed-conditioned entropy is guided toward convergence. item.title: Context Is Not Free: Carbon-Aware LLM Routing for Multi-Turn LLM Web Services across Geo-Distributed Data Centers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

The sustainability of the Web has drawn growing attention, as large language model (LLM)-based web services leave a substantial carbon footprint.

The sustainability of the Web has drawn growing attention, as large language model (LLM)-based web services leave a substantial carbon footprint. These services typically run in geo-distributed data centers whose grid carbon intensity varies across regions and over time, so routing each query to a cleaner region or a smaller model can reduce emissions. A conversation, however, is a stateful web session: each turn reuses the key--value (KV) cache of its history, which resides only where earlier turns were served. Serving a turn on another deployment requires recomputing this history, whose carbon cost grows with the conversation and can outweigh the saving of the move. Existing carbon-aware LLM routers treat a conversation's queries as independent and ignore this cost. We present CarbonRouter, an online framework that jointly selects the model, GPU type, and region for each query to minimize carbon emissions. CarbonRouter introduces a cache-aware carbon cost model, which charges history recomputation to every candidate deployment using cached-token counts from the serving backends, and uses a lightweight gate that keeps a session on its cached deployment when it would likely move ba…

item.title: Concorde: Geometry-Aware Link Prediction via Decoupled Energy Minimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Link prediction remains difficult in sparse graphs, where diffusion heuristics lack connectivity and geometric methods suffer spectral instability when coupling learned representations with diffusion operators.

Link prediction remains difficult in sparse graphs, where diffusion heuristics lack connectivity and geometric methods suffer spectral instability when coupling learned representations with diffusion operators. We introduce Concorde, an energy-based framework that resolves this by decomposing link likelihood into three structurally decoupled branches: (i) a parameter-free spectral anchor that establishes permutation-invariant topological stability; (ii) a mixed-curvature residual on a learnable $\mathbb{H}^{d_h}_{c_h} \times \mathbb{S}^{d_s}_{c_s}$ product manifold, regularized by a feature-aware Ollivier-Ricci curvature proxy; and (iii) a continuous vector field on the tangent bundle of hyperbolic space for non-local structural alignment across topological gaps. The branches are fused via learned gating and trained with an N-pair ranking loss aligned with retrieval-style evaluation. Across five benchmarks spanning sparse, dense, featureless, and attributed regimes, Concorde establishes state-of-the-art early retrieval precision, nearly doubling P@10% over leading baselines in sparse settings.

item.title: Bridging Exploration and Loss of Plasticity in On-Policy Reinforcement Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Deep reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms have been observed to lose the ability to adaptively learn from new data, a phenomenon termed Loss of Plasticity (LoP).

Deep reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms have been observed to lose the ability to adaptively learn from new data, a phenomenon termed Loss of Plasticity (LoP). While many metrics have been shown to correlate with it, the causal mechanisms and the geometric conditions from which it can arise have not been clearly identified. We analyze LoP in Proximal Policy Optimization with isotropic Gaussian policies, the state-of-the-art formulation for many continuous action spaces in RL. We report multiple metrics which characterize the effect that the policy standard deviation $σ$ has on LoP, and we also suggest related explanations for the effectiveness of widely adopted LoP mitigation techniques. We observe a significant effect of $σ$ on the extent of LoP, and accompany this with both theoretical and experimental supporting arguments. Our experimental validation consists of LoP benchmark evaluations against standard baselines as well as real-world policy deployment on a 7-DoF robotic arm.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Redundant context affects attention through two distinct mechanisms: repeated items add normalization mass, while score variation within correlated groups ca...

Redundant context affects attention through two distinct mechanisms: repeated items add normalization mass, while score variation within correlated groups can produce extreme individual scores. We separate these effects in a planted retrieval model with exponentially many Gaussian distractors arranged in known, exponentially large clusters. The model is a two-level generalized random energy model, whose classical free energy yields exact retrieval thresholds. Gaussian interpolation further shows that increasing positive correlation at fixed token count lowers the distractor free energy, unlike adding duplicates. Our main result identifies a sharp limitation of subtracting log cluster size from pre-softmax scores: this correction removes multiplicity but retains within-cluster extremes. Even a temperature chosen after observing all scores cannot lower the required signal below $\sqrt{2α_1}$, where $α_1$ is the exponential rate of the number of clusters. Averaging scores before exponentiation instead suppresses these fluctuations and achieves $\sqrt{2ρα_1}$, where $ρ$ is the within-cluster correlation. Machine learning models in engineering are often used beyond their training conditions, where reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) matters most.

Machine learning models in engineering are often used beyond their training conditions, where reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) matters most. Existing comparisons of regression UQ methods rely on random splits, which assess calibration only in distribution. We introduce a three-rung shift ladder (in distribution, soft shift and hard shift) built along physically meaningful shift variables, and evaluate 12 methods from five families on seven public engineering datasets: five extrapolation settings, an unseen turbofan fault mode and a winter air-quality sensor deployment. All tuning uses source data only. In distribution, conformal methods cover at least 0.946 of test points on every dataset. Under hard shift, mean coverage falls to 0.40-0.75 across the 11 methods that always return an interval, and no systematic difference in method ranks is detected (Friedman p = 0.63). item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

As autonomous research systems become more capable, benchmarks must both evaluate their performance and support meaningful research progress.

As autonomous research systems become more capable, benchmarks must both evaluate their performance and support meaningful research progress. We introduce Auto-Research Arena, a multi-target benchmark for evaluating autonomous research systems and discovering ideas in language modeling. Arena supports diverse research objectives within a shared experimental environment by separating admissibility from improvement: model quality and resource constraints determine whether a result qualifies, while the selected target measures progress among admissible results. We instantiate Arena in language model pretraining with nine targets spanning model, data, training, and inference efficiency, and evaluate seven research harnesses using two foundation models. Arena clearly differentiates existing harnesses across research objectives, with several sophisticated methods outperformed by our simple sequential search baseline, indicating substantial headroom in current auto-research systems. item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

A growing body of work on KV-cache compression aims to reduce the memory requirements of autoregressive generation.

A growing body of work on KV-cache compression aims to reduce the memory requirements of autoregressive generation. These methods compress the stored context while approximately preserving attention computation, enabling generation with reduced memory consumption. Almost tight theoretical results on the worst case space complexity of attention have recently been obtained, but they are achieved by instances where queries can be perfectly aligned with keys. This directly contradicts the observed anisotropy of the key/query geometry in real transformers. In particular, it has been shown empirically that key/query cosine similarities are small even for most correlated pairs, i.e., near-perfect alignment of queries with keys does not happen in practice. In this paper, we study the space complexity of attention approximation under the assumption that key/query cosine similarities belong to a small interval around zero, i.e., a query cannot align too much with any key. We give a nearly space optimal algorithm and a corresponding space lower bound. item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Safety fine-tuning can make undesirable model behaviors sufficiently rare that measuring their frequency by direct sampling becomes prohibitively expensive.

Safety fine-tuning can make undesirable model behaviors sufficiently rare that measuring their frequency by direct sampling becomes prohibitively expensive. We introduce Amplify, Locate, Estimate (ALE), a method for estimating such rare failure probabilities efficiently. ALE uses the change in token log-probabilities induced by the safety fine-tuning to define an amplification direction, along which we increase the failure rate for cheap measurement. We develop a score-function estimator that uses the selected amplified batch to recover the local slope of the log failure rate from the token probabilities of the sampled failures, enabling extrapolation back to rare target rates. We also use the amplified batch to obtain an importance-sampling estimate. Across 41 evaluation targets, ALE's estimate-to-reference ratios have a median close to one, with 37 ALE estimates within a factor of three of reference values obtained from independent direct measurements. item.title: AgriDefend: A $205 Offline Edge Device that Detects Crop Stress Before Visible Symptoms via Multimodal AI Fusion
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 田间作物监测设备多为单一模态（冠层相机或土壤探针），无法在症状可见前发现地下起始的胁迫。

方法 AgriDefend 融合两模态：MobileNetV2 CNN 分析冠层图像，Random Forest 整合单土壤探针趋势特征（湿度、pH 变化率、N/P/K、地下 CO2 相对环境），logistic 回归元学习器融合为五类作物健康预测；在 Raspberry Pi 5 上离线运行，无云无蜂窝链路。

关键数字 温室干旱试验（野生萝卜）融合模型 87% 准确率（R²=0.88、MAE=0.05），1.4s INT8 TensorFlow Lite 推理；土壤信号比可见萎蔫早约 4 天；物料清单 205 美元，约为商用同类节点 1/5。

为什么值得看 205 美元离线多模态边缘设备实证，无连接场景可持续作物监测的消费电子级方案。

Many high-throughput scientific experiments produce distributional outputs, requiring conditional generative models to interpret the data, and to predict out...

Many high-throughput scientific experiments produce distributional outputs, requiring conditional generative models to interpret the data, and to predict outcomes at new inputs. Acquiring experimental data at new conditions (e.g., for a new antigen or a new cell type) is often expensive, motivating the need for automated experimental design methods. However, existing active learning frameworks are limited as they assume scalar or vector-valued outputs. We first show that the Wasserstein test risk of a conditional generative task decomposes into a mean term and a shape term, demonstrating why mean-based active learning is blind to distributional shape. To capture both, we propose the transport Neural Tangent Kernel (tNTK), a tractable kernel that measures how sensitive a generative model's predicted distribution is with respect to its parameters. The tNTK recovers the standard NTK in the deterministic limit and upper-bounds the posterior Fréchet variance of the prediction under small parameter perturbations. item.title: Accelerating SO(2)-Equivariant Materials Models through Low-Precision Emulation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Rotationally equivariant architectures improve the physical fidelity of machine-learned (ML) universal materials models based on graph neural networks (GNNs).

Rotationally equivariant architectures improve the physical fidelity of machine-learned (ML) universal materials models based on graph neural networks (GNNs). However, their scalability is limited by the use of non-trivial, high-precision tensor operations during both training and inference. Adopting the reduced-precision formats of matrix multiplication units (MMUs), e.g., FP8 instead of FP32, provides massive increases in throughput, up to 30x (60x) on NVIDIA Hopper (Blackwell) GPUs, but may lead to drastic loss of accuracy. Here, we introduce tailored 'emulated' low-precision operations under the integer Ozaki scheme to accelerate the 'SO(2)-equivariant' processing layers of GNNs, which dominate the runtime of (1) many state-of-the-art ML interatomic potentials (MLIPs) and (2) most universal ML Hamiltonian (MLH) models. Our framework, FlashSO(2), outperforms TF32, the most accurate native low-precision MMU format, in throughput, accuracy, and memory footprint at once. Rotationally equivariant architectures improve the physical fidelity of machine-learned (ML) universal materials models based on graph neural networks (GNNs). item.title: AHEAD: Adaptive Neural Acceleration for Large-Scale Linear Programming
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Large-scale linear programs with millions of variables and constraints strain time and memory budgets.

Large-scale linear programs with millions of variables and constraints strain time and memory budgets. First-order methods such as the primal-dual hybrid gradient scale to this regime because they avoid matrix factorizations, but they require many iterations. Learned accelerators can reduce these iterations, yet fewer iterations do not guarantee a shorter solve. Learning inference also takes time, and running the accelerator longer trades solver time for inference time. Existing unrolled accelerators handle this trade-off poorly: each layer processes every variable and constraint, the predicted iterates still need solver refinement, and every instance runs the same layers. We therefore ask: What neural accelerator design achieves end-to-end speedups on large-scale linear programs across sizes and target accuracies? We introduce AHEAD, an accelerator that predicts step sizes for first-order linear programming solvers while keeping their update rules. Its weight-shared predictor reads compact solver statistics and rescales the primal and dual step sizes, so each warm-start iteration stays inexpensive and a short warm-start phase hands the solver a warm start. A learned handoff policy…

item.title: A Unified Queueing-Based Framework for Comparative Evaluation of Serverless Autoscaling Strategies under Bursty Workloads
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Serverless computing platforms must preserve quality of service (QoS) while adapting to highly bursty and unpredictable workloads.

Serverless computing platforms must preserve quality of service (QoS) while adapting to highly bursty and unpredictable workloads. To cope with workload fluctuations while satisfying QoS requirements and service-level agreements (SLAs), these platforms rely on automatic resource scaling. Commercial function-as-a-service (FaaS) platforms employ different autoscaling strategies to dynamically adjust the number of active function instances and the available processing capacity. In this work, three representative autoscaling strategies are modeled and compared: scale-per-request (SPR), concurrencylevel scaling (CLS), and metric-based scaling (MBS). To enable systematic evaluation independent of proprietary platform-specific implementations, we develop a unified modeling framework that combines analytical queueing network (QN) modeling with queueing Petri nets (QPN) implemented in Java Modeling Tools (JMT) to evaluate autoscaling behavior under two-phase hyper-exponential (H2) arrivals. Evaluation is conducted using four system-level metrics: throughput, mean response time, system population, and system power. item.title: A Graph-informed Kriging model for sample-efficient Bayesian optimization of wind farm layouts
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-26　分类：论文PDF

Wind farm layout optimization becomes increasingly difficult as turbine count grows, especially when high-fidelity aerodynamic models are used.

Wind farm layout optimization becomes increasingly difficult as turbine count grows, especially when high-fidelity aerodynamic models are used. Conventional Kriging-based Bayesian optimization often suffers from low sample efficiency in high-dimensional layout spaces because sparse training data provide limited domain coverage. We develop a Graph-informed Kriging framework that embeds reusable aerodynamic interaction information into the surrogate mean function. The wind farm is represented as a directed aerodynamic graph, where pairwise turbine interactions defined in a low-dimensional relative-coordinate space are assembled into a farm-scale mean. This structured mean captures the dominant variation in annual energy production (AEP), allowing the Gaussian process to model only the residual structure and uncertainty. Numerical experiments show that Graph-informed Kriging consistently improves AEP prediction accuracy over ordinary and generic-trend Kriging under sparse-data conditions, with increasing benefits as layout dimension and wake-interaction strength grow. Embedded in Bayesian optimization, it substantially improves sample efficiency and achieves competitive solutions for …

item.title: llama.cpp b11888 common, grammar: add recursive depth limit, make it a requirement (#31153)
item.description:
发表方：llama.cpp（GitHub Releases）　发布：2026-10-25　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题 grammar 采样对候选 token 的拒绝逻辑存在栈溢出与误拒风险。

要点 原先 llama_grammar_reject_candidates_for_stack 的深度限制按 token 的码点数量计数，导致任何长度 ≥256 字符的 token 在 grammar 下必然被拒——例如 GLM-4.7-Flash 的 512 空格 token、Laguna-S-2.1 的长空格 token。改为用自己的层级栈遍历码点、不再递归，于是没有限制也没有栈风险，掩码与 master 一致；同时把被拒候选记录为输入中的下标，并补齐若干递归函数与 peg 解析器清理。

关键数字 触发门槛原为 256 字符；作者称 GLM-4.7/Laguna/Qwen3.6/gemma-4 的 json、list、spaces grammar 均快于 master。

为什么值得看 这是"合法输出被静默拒绝"的真实 bug，且命中的是特定模型的保留 token——排查起来几乎没有线索，文中的根因定位值得记住。

item.title: llama.cpp b11883 llama-quant: fix 4D tensor quantization using ggml_nrows() and name-based expert detection (#30820)
item.description:
发表方：llama.cpp（GitHub Releases）　发布：2026-10-25　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题 llama-quant 在 4D 张量与 MoE 专家张量识别上的两处误判。

要点 其一，nrows_total 原按 ne[1]ne[2] 计算，4D 张量只有前 ne[2] 个切片被量化、其余行被丢弃，改用 ggml_nrows(tensor) 计入 ne[3]（修复 issue #29916）。其二，MXFP4_MOE 路径原先用 ne[2] > 1 判断 MoE 专家张量，对 3 维及以上的非专家张量（如 MLA 投影 BailingMoE3、4D 卷积核）会误判，改为按张量名识别——所有用于 GGML_OP_MUL_MAT_ID 的张量均以 _exps 或 *_chexps 命名，并借此删除 BailingMoE3 特例。

关键数字 同时修正 imatrix 尺寸：4D 张量下应为 ne[0]ne[2]ne[3] 而非 ne[0]*ne[2]，与 llama_tensor_quantize_impl 的按行索引方式一致。

为什么值得看 静默丢行和专家张量误判都属于"量化结果不可信但程序不报错"的类型，踩到的人往往只看到精度异常而查不到根因。

item.title: llama.cpp b11879 CUDA: fuse FFN gate/up matmuls and GLU in MMQ with interleaved gate/up rows (#29948)
item.description:
发表方：llama.cpp（GitHub Releases）　发布：2026-10-25　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题 CUDA 后端能否把稠密 FFN 的 gate/up 两个矩阵乘与 GLU 融合成一次 launch。

要点 面向 prompt 处理，把 gate 与 up 的 matmul 合并为单次 mul_mat_q 启动，GLU 改在写回阶段由寄存器计算并只写一半行；loader 以 gate 权重为第二指针，按 8 行一组把 up 与 gate 交错填入权重 tile，使每线程同时持有 up 值与匹配的 gate 值（MMA tile 的 r 与 r+8 行）；MMA 主循环的 tile、warp 布局、vec_dot 与每线程一个 sum[] 保持不变，融合路径使用常规 tiling（不含 stream-k）并让列 tile 最内层以使相邻 block 共享权重 tile。

关键数字 启用范围为 Q4_K、Q5_K、Q6_K、Q8_0、IQ4_XS，硬件限定 NVIDIA Turing 及更新架构；同一批提交还处理了融合 MMQ 参数断言、hint 检查迁移到 should_fuse、prec_src1 传递与"仅在高效 tiling 且无 fallback 时才融合"的收敛条件。

为什么值得看 这是把 FFN 前向中一次 kernel 启动与一次权重读取省掉的实打实优化，量化到 4-bit 之后 FFN 访存正是吞吐瓶颈所在。

item.title: llama.cpp b11876 vulkan: one warp tile per subgroup in the small matmul tiles (#30106)
item.description:
发表方：llama.cpp（GitHub Releases）　发布：2026-10-25　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题 Vulkan 小矩阵乘 tile 在不同 subgroup 宽度下的正确性 bug。

要点 修复前小 tile 的 warp tile 宽度固定为 32（8 宽 subgroup 时为 8），与 tile 的 BLOCK_SIZE 和 WARP 无关。16 宽 subgroup（如 Mali）下第二个 subgroup 会写进下一个 tile 的列；8 宽 subgroup 时部分 _id tile 的行从未被计算。修法是让每个 subgroup 恰好分到一个 warp tile。

关键数字 修复前在 Pixel 9 上有 20 个 MUL_MAT 与 6 个 MUL_MAT_ID 测试失败，修复后全部通过（对应上游 issue #28637）；改动标注由 Claude Opus 5.5 协助完成。

为什么值得看 这是典型的"只在特定 GPU 上出现"类 bug——Mali 与 Pixel 9 用户此前拿到的结果可能是错的，数值正确性问题比性能问题更值得警惕。

item.title: llama.cpp b11875 hexagon: generic dims collapse/reshape for unary, binary and matmul ops (#31071)
item.description:
发表方：llama.cpp（GitHub Releases）　发布：2026-10-25　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题 骁龙 DSP（Hexagon）后端算子如何处理多维张量，才能真正吃满端侧多核。

要点 该版本把 unary、binary 与 matmul 算子的维度折叠/reshape 统一为通用逻辑：全部折叠处理放到 host 侧完成并泛化，unary 的折叠策略在行数较少时补充拆分，移除残留的 unary 辅助函数；配套 hex-tools 的 profile.py 增加 --compare 选项。

关键数字 改动集中在 4 个提交：host 侧统一折叠与泛化、unary 小行数时拆分、profile.py 支持 --compare、清理 unary 辅助函数；发布 attestations 明确包含 Linux arm64（Snapdragon：CPU、Adreno GPU、Hexagon NPU）配置。

为什么值得看 Hexagon 正是手机端 NPU 与 DSP 的落点，把维度折叠从算子内部特例变成 host 侧通用机制，后续所有端侧算子都能受益，比单个算子优化更基础。

item.title: llama.cpp b11873 opencl: add initial q2_k support (#30999)
item.description:
发表方：llama.cpp（GitHub Releases）　发布：2026-10-25　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题 移动 GPU 上的极低比特（q2_k）推理路径此前缺失，本次补齐到什么程度。

要点 OpenCL 后端新增 q2_k 的 mul_mv、SOA 向量乘与 tiled 矩阵乘，并实现面向 Adreno 的 noshuffle gemm/gemv 与 dp4a gemm，随后对 Adreno 做了 kernel 调优。代码由高通方面工程师共同提交。

关键数字 覆盖 4 条 kernel 路径（mul_mv_q2_k_f32、SOA mv、tiled mm、Adreno noshuffle/dp4a gemm）；发布随附的 attestations 包含 Windows arm64 OpenCL Adreno、Linux arm64 Snapdragon（CPU/Adreno GPU/Hexagon NPU）、CUDA 12/13、Vulkan、ROCm 10.0 等矩阵。

为什么值得看 q2_k 是 2-bit 级部署的最后一档，它的 Adreno 专用路径决定了 2-bit 模型在手机 GPU 上是否真能跑得动，而不只是"能编译"。

item.title: llama.cpp b11870 model: DSV4.1 flash (#31086)
item.description:
发表方：llama.cpp（GitHub Releases）　发布：2026-10-25　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题 端侧推理框架如何接入 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 这个新 MoE 架构。

要点 该版本新增 deepseek41 模型支持：移除 MXFP8、把 Engram 表格转成 BF16、在 cache 内一次算完压缩 KV 读取层、参照 qwen4exp 在图内 gather Engram 行以去掉 host 侧 gather、每个 Engram 层各存一份哈希常量，并删除 LLAMA_DSV41_KV_MIRROR 开关。

关键数字 本次共 10 个 deepseek41 相关提交（含 Engram 表格转 BF16、图内 gather、top-k 行排序后再做稀疏 gather），并把 deepseek41 纳入 Metal fusion 测试基线；发布携带 macOS/iOS、Linux、CUDA 12/13、ROCm 10.0、OpenVINO、SYCL、Vulkan 及 Snapdragon（CPU/Adreno/Hexagon NPU）等多平台 attestations。

为什么值得看 新一代旗舰 MoE 架构进入开源推理栈通常意味着几周内的适配跟进，这份改动清单本身就是端侧部署该模型的踩坑清单。

item.title: Valid Early Detection of Memorization in Diffusion Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

Diffusion models can sometimes reproduce examples from their training data, a phenomenon known as memorization.

Diffusion models can sometimes reproduce examples from their training data, a phenomenon known as memorization. Existing memorization detection methods for unconditional diffusion models typically operate at a pre-selected timestep and therefore cannot adapt the detection time to the evolving denoising trajectory. Sequential monitoring enables adaptive detection but repeated testing across timesteps complicates trajectory-level false-alarm control. We study two ways of combining split conformal calibration with sequential monitoring for prompt-free memorization detection: per-step Bonferroni calibration and direct trajectory-level calibration of the maximum memorization score. The former controls repeated testing by splitting the false-alarm budget across timesteps, whereas the latter calibrates the event of ever crossing a threshold directly through the trajectory-level maximum. We evaluate this formulation on an unconditional CIFAR-10 EDM using two complementary per-step statistics based on geometry and representation spikiness. Experiments show that sequential monitoring improves the power-timing tradeoff over fixed-time detection. Compared with Bonferroni calibration, trajector…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Toward Near-Optimal Floorplanning with Complex Design Constraints for Modern SoCs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

Modern system-on-chip (SoC) floorplanning is increasingly challenged by highly coupled complex design constraints.

Modern system-on-chip (SoC) floorplanning is increasingly challenged by highly coupled complex design constraints. Existing methods often relax constraints into objectives via multi-objective optimization, leading to infeasible solutions or degraded quality. To address this, we formulate the problem as a constrained optimization task and propose a novel three-stage analytical framework integrating semidefinite programming (SDP), augmented Lagrangian method (ALM), and second-order cone programming (SOCP), which enforces constraints more rigorously and achieves higher-quality solutions. First, we adopt a two-step SDP formulation to obtain a robust initialization in the non-convex search space. Next, we incorporate differentiable objectives and constraints into an incremental ALM to jointly handle coupled design constraints during global floorplanning. Finally, an SOCP-based legalization strictly enforces feasibility while further reducing area. Experiments on the FloorSet benchmark show that our method satisfies all constraints with the fastest runtime. Compared with state-of-the-art methods, it reduces wirelength and area by 90\% and 16\% on average, and achieves near-optimal result…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: The Symmetry of Differential Neural Tangent Kernel under the Orthogonal Group
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

The differential neural tangent kernel (DNTK) is a tool for analyzing the training dynamics of overparameterized physics informed neural networks.

The differential neural tangent kernel (DNTK) is a tool for analyzing the training dynamics of overparameterized physics informed neural networks. In this work, we investigate the symmetry of the infinite DNTK under an orthogonal group, for two layer and deep neural networks separately, based on the explicit expression of the DNTK and recursive formula, respectively. The results are for all activations with or without a bias term, and shed insight into the structure of the infinite width DNTK. Then we prove that the integral operators over the unit sphere induced by operators from the same group orbit share the spectrum, and their reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces differ only by an orthogonal transformation, and that the operator fixed DNTK exhibits zonal symmetry on the unit sphere for symmetric operators. Thus the eigenvalue decay rate of the associated integral operator can be derived for shallow networks with RePU activation and zero bias initialization.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

In this work, we investigate the symmetry of the infinite DNTK under an orthogonal group, for two layer and deep neural networks separately, based on the explicit expression of the DNTK and recursive formula, respectively. The results are for all activations with or without a bias term, and shed insight into the structure of the infinite width DNTK. Then we prove that the integral operators over the unit sphere induced by operators from the same group orbit share the spectrum, and their reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces differ only by an orthogonal transformation, and that the operator fixed DNTK exhibits zonal symmetry on the unit sphere for symmetric operators. Thus the eigenvalue decay rate of the associated integral operator can be derived for shallow networks with RePU activation and zero bias initialization.

item.title: Steering the Teacher: Improving On-Policy Self-Distillation for Thinking Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a student on its own reasoning trajectories using token-level supervision from a reference-conditioned teacher init...

On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a student on its own reasoning trajectories using token-level supervision from a reference-conditioned teacher initialized from the same model. However, access to the reference can induce teacher behaviors that undermine independent reasoning in thinking models, leading to reference hallucinations, where the student cites an unavailable reference to justify reasoning steps, and reconsideration suppression, where the teacher discourages verification and revision at uncertain steps. We introduce Steered-Teacher OPSD (ST-OPSD) to jointly address these failure modes through activation steering. ST-OPSD extracts two directions from model-generated reasoning trajectories and applies them to the teacher's hidden states during distillation target computation, suppressing reference-invoking behavior and encouraging reconsideration with marker-family calibration. The student learns from the resulting teacher distributions without being steered. Experiments on AIME and HMMT show that ST-OPSD improves accuracy over vanilla OPSD and other interventions while restoring reconsideration and reference-hallucination rates to base-model levels.

item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 MoE 投机解码中连续 token 常选同一批专家，去重引擎每 pass 每专家只读一次、请求字节更少，但它在什么条件下真的更快？

方法 把一步时间写成各 kernel 请求字节/有效带宽加固定时间，几何接受假设下推导投机快于普通解码的条件，最优草稿长度为接受率的单调阶梯；在 llama.cpp Metal、MLX-LM 与 llama.cpp CUDA 上实测（已改造支持去重）。

关键数字 per-slot kernel 有效带宽更高（r=0.32 到 0.75），去重仅每 pass 5-8 token 或从不更快；实测节省落在误差界内：CUDA/MLX-LM 全部点、Metal 48 点中 36 点；DeepSeek-V2-Lite 上 CUDA 最优草稿长度在 22 个接受率上全部命中（±1 内）。

为什么值得看 把 MoE 投机解码的字节/带宽账算清楚，直接指导草稿长度与去重取舍。

item.title: Sparse Sum-of-Squares Layers for Certified Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

A central limitation of modern machine learning systems is the lack of formal certificates guaranteeing their behavior beyond empirical, sample-based evaluat...

A central limitation of modern machine learning systems is the lack of formal certificates guaranteeing their behavior beyond empirical, sample-based evaluation. Sum-of-squares (SOS) methods provide such guarantees by certifying polynomial inequalities over continuous domains via semidefinite programming (SDP). While prior work has introduced SDP layers as differentiable components in neural networks, repeated learning calls can lose the computational benefit of the forward program's sparse representation. We propose Sparse SOS Layers, differentiable value layers whose backward passes reuse the local coordinates of the forward solve. Under a fixed template and learned objective coefficients, each layer avoids building dense certificates and reuses its sparse structure across training steps. Compared with existing methods, our approach achieves up to 2.7 times speedup in total warm-call time, with nearly 100 times lower memory usage (1.7 vs. 160 GiB) for relatively large problem sizes for the tested dense parameterization. Experiments cover sparse polynomial certification, pendulum control, combinatorial relaxations, robotics projection, oscillator chains, and pose graph synchroniza…

item.title: Single-Cycle Battery Remaining Useful Life Prediction with Compressed Continuous Wavelet Features and Deep Neural Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

Lithium-ion batteries are widely used in industrial applications, but their performance gradually degrades over time, making accurate lifetime prediction imp...

Lithium-ion batteries are widely used in industrial applications, but their performance gradually degrades over time, making accurate lifetime prediction important for safety and reliability. However, reliable lifetime assessment generally requires extensive degradation testing, which is both costly and time-consuming. To reduce this burden, recent data-driven approaches have sought to predict the end-of-life cycle of batteries from only the initial few cycles. Nevertheless, identifying reliable degradation patterns from such limited early-cycle data remains challenging because early aging dynamics are often subtle and nonlinear. To address this issue, we adopt the continuous wavelet transform to convert cycle-wise voltage, current, and capacity signals into time-frequency representations, enabling multi-resolution characterization of degradation behavior. Building on this representation, we apply scale compression to reduce redundancy while preserving structural information in the scalograms. We evaluate the proposed framework on eight benchmark datasets derived from seven public battery datasets covering diverse electrode chemistries, cell form factors, and cycling protocols. Exp…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) enables large language models (LLMs) to continuously self-improve their reasoning capabilities.

Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) enables large language models (LLMs) to continuously self-improve their reasoning capabilities. Compared to RLVR's scalar rewards, recent self-supervised on-policy distillation methods leverage denser supervision signals. However, both paradigms suffer from exploration bottlenecks, struggling to escape local optima when the policy fails to sample valid solutions. Relying on external demonstrations can bypass this issue; however, the off-policy nature hinders genuine self-improvement and the mismatched-distribution reasoning can not be fully exploited. In this work, we propose Self-Evolution Policy Optimization (SEPO), a framework that drives continuous reasoning capability evolution via guided exploration and in-distribution exploitation. Specifically, SEPO utilizes labels to elicit correct reasoning from the policy, unlocking the exploration potential. By treating current policy conditioned on this in-distribution reasoning as a self-teacher, SEPO distills the newly discovered solution back into the policy. Through this iterative cycle of policy-intrinsic exploration and exploitation, SEPO achieves robust and continuous capabil…

Looped language models such as Ouro reuse one block of layers several times per token.

Looped language models such as Ouro reuse one block of layers several times per token. A rollout engine can batch the deeper loops of several response positions and run them only when a deep readout is due. This deferred schedule is fast, but the learner of an on-policy RL algorithm recomputes the sampled tokens' log-probabilities with a dense pass, and the two computations differ in floating point: in FP32 at 4096 tokens about 18% of the sampled tokens miss a $10^{-5}$ same-weight gate, and with bf16 weights nearly every token does. item.title: SRA: Selective Residual Adaptation for LLM Reasoning Enhancement
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

Knowledge distillation transfers reasoning capabilities from large language models to lightweight students.

Knowledge distillation transfers reasoning capabilities from large language models to lightweight students. However, distilled small models still struggle with multi-step reasoning. We observe that the distribution divergences between teacher and student models along reasoning paths are highly sparse, and target tokens almost always fall within the student top-$K$ candidate set. Based on this finding, unlike approaches updating student backbones or requiring runtime teacher computation, we propose Selective Residual Adaptation (SRA), a plug-and-play framework that internalizes localized corrections. Concretely, SRA employs a Discrepancy Gate to identify divergence positions alongside a Candidate Residual Adapter for top-$K$ logit calibration to correct the mismatch. Theoretically, we establish error bounds ensuring strict sequence level performance gains. Across mathematical benchmarks on Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 4B, SRA consistently enhances distilled student models, raising average Pass@16 by up to 4.37 percentage points while preserving general capabilities.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: SHIFT-JEV: Certified Abstention and Gain-Gated Continual Adaptation for LLM-Based Decision Models under Distribution Shift
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

Large language models (LLMs) can act as decision models that return a probability distribution over a fixed set of options, but deployed decision models face...

Large language models (LLMs) can act as decision models that return a probability distribution over a fixed set of options, but deployed decision models face domain, label-prior, emerging-class and candidate-set shift. We study how such models fail under shift and propose SHIFT-Jev, a monitoring, abstention and continual-adaptation procedure for them. It scores the risk of each decision from uncertainty, format and option-consistency signals, certifies abstention thresholds with Learn-then-Test, monitors the decision stream with drift and label-shift detectors, and accepts a model update only when an expected-gain gate finds a significant held-out improvement without loss on earlier regimes. On a benchmark of ten shifted test environments with Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-4B (three seeds each) and Phi-4-mini, fine-tuning with KL anchors and temperature scaling lowers calibration error under shift from 0.289 to 0.087. item.title: SGL: Towards a Bridging Model for Heterogeneous Hierarchical Platforms
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

This paper introduces the Scatter-Gather parallel-programming and parallel-execution model in the form of a simple imperative Scatter-Gather Language (SGL).

This paper introduces the Scatter-Gather parallel-programming and parallel-execution model in the form of a simple imperative Scatter-Gather Language (SGL). Its design is based on past experience with bulk-synchronous parallel (BSP) programming and BSP language design. SGL's novel features are motivated by the last decade's move towards multi-level and heterogeneous parallel architectures involving multi-core processors, graphics accelerators and hierarchical routing networks in the largest multiprocessing systems. The design of SGL is coherent with L. Valiant's Multi-BSP while offering a programming interface that is even simpler than the primitives of Bulk-Synchronous Parallel ML (BSML). SGL appears to cover a large subset of all BSP algorithms while avoiding complex message-passing programming. Like all BSP-inspired systems, it supports predictable, portable and scalable performance. Moreover, SGL's explicit data distribution will allow automatic or programmable load-balancing.

item.title: SEEK: Skill Extraction with Evolving Knowledge against Frontier Science Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

Science agents increasingly package domain expertise as reusable skills that plan analyses, select tools, and execute workflows.

Science agents increasingly package domain expertise as reusable skills that plan analyses, select tools, and execute workflows. This modularity creates a confidentiality risk: the interactions that deliver a skill's capability can also reveal the skill itself. We build an extensible benchmark of 40 protected skills across eight open- and closed-source science-agent platforms, comparing direct, fixed-strategy, and bandit-guided iterative probing under reference-based and reference-free evaluation. Leakage is pervasive: all eight platforms (100%) leak at least one protected skill, and four reach 100% attack success under a single direct request. To stress-test platforms that resist simple probing, we propose SEEK (Skill Extraction with Evolving Knowledge), a black-box, self-evolving red-teaming agent that consolidates response-derived evidence in persistent memory and evolves reusable attack skills, using only user-visible responses. On 12 skills from SpatialAgent and Biomni, SEEK achieves 100% attack success while reducing the mean first-success round by 31.8% and 38.2% relative to bandit-guided probing. Leakage is pervasive: all eight platforms (100%) leak at least one protected skill, and four reach 100% attack success under a single direct request. To stress-test platforms that resist simple probing, we propose SEEK (Skill Extraction with Evolving Knowledge), a black-box, self-evolving red-teaming agent that consolidates response-derived evidence in persistent memory and evolves reusable attack skills, using only user-visible responses. On 12 skills from SpatialAgent and Biomni, SEEK achieves 100% attack success while reducing the mean first-success round by 31.8% and 38.2% relative to bandit-guided probing. item.title: ResCom: Activation Residual Compensation for Large Language Model Quantization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 低比特权重-激活量化部署中激活舍入仍损伤精度：从舍入后输入重建无法区分同一 bin 内不同激活——如何补偿层输出误差？

方法 ResCom 低秩校正：用激活舍入残差补偿层输出误差；输出感知标定按残差方向对输出重建的贡献选方向，闭式求解，无需梯度训练、不改已标定权重。

关键数字 Llama-3-8B 4bit 权重+激活：rank-32 注意力校正使 WikiText-2 困惑度 7.708→7.147，MMLU +2.89 个百分点，5-shot GSM8K 23.96%→36.16%；1B–70B 验证；FP32 实现 4K prefill +2.25%，紧凑存储较 FP16 保留 27.7% 峰值内存节省。

为什么值得看 免训练的激活量化误差补偿，数字扎实，直接服务 W4A4 部署。

item.title: Qwen3.8 Flash Next: 3-bit near 16-bit accuracy, with MTP prefix caching
item.description:
发表方：ElioVP Blog　发布：2026-10-25　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题 3-bit 量化权重能否逼近 16-bit 精度，长对话里前缀缓存与 MTP 能否同时生效。

要点 10 月 24 日发布的新 3-bit Qwen3.8 Flash Next 权重不改格式、体积与 kernel，只调整各专家输出投影的校准统计、扩充到约 400 万 token 校准集、保留 3-bit 专家之外的 8-bit 共享层；native worker 让 GPU 不再跑 PyTorch，vLLM 只提供 API 与调度。

关键数字 三项文本任务上 3-bit 与 16-bit 的差异均不具统计显著性，HumanEval 低 1.8 点（配对 95% 区间 −5.0 ~ +1.3）；重复 200K token 提示的缓存命中恢复 0.68s vs 冷启动 25.81s；262,144 token 窗口 213.5 tok/s（开 RAM 层）/250.0 tok/s（关）。

为什么值得看 "3-bit 逼近 16-bit"目前只在文本任务上成立，作者自陈并不等价，视觉端亦未验证原生图像输入；而前缀缓存叠加 MTP 对多轮 coding agent 的等待收益更实在。

item.title: QECGBERT: A Scalable ECG Foundation Model Based on Self-Supervised Language Learning via VQ-VAE Waveform Tokenization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

AI foundation models play a pivotal role in advancing heart disease diagnosis from electrocardiogram (ECG) data, particularly for rare diseases where the lac...

AI foundation models play a pivotal role in advancing heart disease diagnosis from electrocardiogram (ECG) data, particularly for rare diseases where the lack of sufficient labeled data hinders supervised learning. However, most self-supervised learning methods treat ECGs as generic sequence or image data without exploiting underlying physiological structure. To address this limitation, we propose QECGBERT, a self-supervised ECG language model that explicitly encodes physiological semantics by tokenizing the P, QRS, T, and isoelectric background waveforms. Vector-quantized variational autoencoder (VQ-VAE) tokenization is applied to each 12-lead ECG, with tokens enriched by continuous waveform features to preserve morphology lost during quantization without increasing sequence length. This design enables compact BERT masked language modeling with short sequences, improving scalability and reducing computational cost relative to long-sequence approaches. QECGBERT applies BERT pre-training to the MIMIC-IV dataset containing over 800,000 unlabeled ECG recordings, and fine-tuning on labeled PTB-XL, CPSC2018, and Chapman--Shaoxing--Ningbo datasets for evaluation. The results demonstrate …

item.title: Prefix Keys and Values Matter Late: RIPE Caching for Self-Speculative Decoding in Looped Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 循环语言模型每 token 把一层块跑 R 次，KV 缓存每循环层有 R 个平面，自投机解码读全部平面；哪些平面更重要、能否只存最深平面？

方法 发现前缀 K/V 后期更敏感：等扰动下 loop 25-32 比 loop 2-9 敏感 e^15.0（Huginn-0125）/ e^12.8（Raven-Llama）倍，平面按 0.88/0.81 每循环几何逼近最后一层；RIPE 只在最近位置窗口保留全深度，其余位置只存最深平面。

关键数字 Huginn 上 64 位置窗口以全缓存 11.9% 内存移除 89% 尾部位置；全缓存自投机加速 2.09x、仅最深平面 2.58x；单共享平面的固定内存吞吐增益 2.24x。

为什么值得看 循环模型"后期 KV 平面最敏感"的结构洞察+省约 88% 内存的缓存策略。

item.title: ParetoRSI-Gym: Can AI Agents Improve Language Models Across Multiple Domains?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires an agentic system to design, train, and evaluate its own successor.

Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires an agentic system to design, train, and evaluate its own successor. Data-driven post-training is a central part of that loop, yet existing evaluations measure it on a single benchmark, where an agent selects from a static pool or distills a stronger model to push one score up in one run. Real post-training is multi-domain, and a gain in one domain has to be weighed against a regression in another. We propose ParetoRSI-Gym, in which an agent searches for data, curates it, trains, reads back per-domain results, and repeats, with everything but the data held fixed: the initial LLM, the five domains (math, code, finance, medicine, science), the toolset, and the SFT pipeline. Generalization benchmarks in each domain separate capability gains from overfitting to the scores the agent optimizes against. Across three agent systems, three base models, five rounds and multiple seeds, the strongest system, Claude Code with Opus-5, raises the generalization scores of its proxy-best checkpoint by 9.2% relative to the starting model (+2.3 absolute points), averaged with equal weight over three base models and five domains, with a single-domain relative ga…

item.title: NovaFabric: A Black-Box Recorder for AI Agents with Sealed, Replayable, Diffable and Auditable Runs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

An AI agent run is no longer a function call.

An AI agent run is no longer a function call. It is a cascade of prompts, model calls, tool invocations, file and network effects and sub-agents. When such a run misbehaves, or an auditor asks what happened, logs and traces answer poorly: they are mutable, partial and cannot be re-executed. This technical report describes NovaFabric, an open-source (Apache-2.0) black-box recorder for AI agents that turns a run into a sealed, replayable, diffable and auditable evidence capsule. The design rests on two formats only. The Run Capsule is a directory of flat files and the source of truth; every database is a rebuildable index over capsules. The Evidence Bundle is the signed export for an auditor. Everything else follows existing standards: OpenTelemetry GenAI, OpenLineage, W3C PROV, in-toto/DSSE, RFC 3161 and CycloneDX. A single-node run is the smallest case of a distributed one; the schema supports a capsule hierarchy for Slurm arrays and Kubernetes jobs, though automatic parent finalization is library-only today. The report covers the architecture and the engines behind the verb chain capture, seal, replay, diff and audit: fail-closed mocked replay; a diff gate with a stable exit-code …

item.title: Minimax Regret for Sobolev Kernel-Based Reinforcement Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

We study the minimax regret rate for episodic kernel-based reinforcement learning, where the expected reward and transition density belong to a Sobolev repro...

We study the minimax regret rate for episodic kernel-based reinforcement learning, where the expected reward and transition density belong to a Sobolev reproducing kernel Hilbert space, with continuous state and action spaces, and adversarial initial states. For Sobolev smoothness parameter $ν>0$, state dimension $d_S$, and action dimension $d_A$, we prove that the minimax expected regret over $T$ episodes is $\widetildeΘ(T^{\max\{e_A,e_B\}})$, where $e_A=\frac{ν+d_A}{2ν+d_A}$, $e_B=\frac{ν+d_A+3d_S/2}{2ν+d_A+2d_S}$ with the other model parameters fixed. The two exponents reflect the distinct difficulties of action selection and learning across states. We introduce Sobolev Optimal Value Iteration (SOVI), which attains this rate from observed rewards and transitions. For fixed smoothness and reference-kernel lengthscale, its regret bound has a prefactor polynomial in the state-action dimension $d=d_S+d_A$, horizon $H$, transition and reward RKHS norm bounds $u,B_r$, and kernel norm-comparison factor $Λ$, up to logarithmic factors. The algorithm separates initial action selection from continuation-value estimation and combines local polynomial approximation with the shared RKHS struc…

item.title: MOFjson: An Explicit Topological Representation of Metal-Organic Frameworks for Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

Language models for metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) rely on formats that separate atomic geometry from structural topology, forcing models to choose between ...

Language models for metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) rely on formats that separate atomic geometry from structural topology, forcing models to choose between unstructured coordinate lists and non-spatial string identifiers[1]. We present MOFjson, the first representation separating structural data into a raw atomic layer with explicit bond shift vectors and a derived layer exposing secondary building units (metal nodes and organic linkers) and network topology. Additionally, we introduce a benchmark with crystal-derived ground truth across four question categories. Across four models, MOFjson beats all three baselines in every category: 100% vs. 18-47% on reaching a block's nearest periodic copy, 96% vs. 71% on crystal system characterisation, and 60% vs. 48% on metal node and organic linker coordination. Ablating shift labels drops accuracy to 12.7%, proving models read the periodic graph rather than the surface format. MOFjson gives language models structure to read rather than reconstruct, establishing a foundation for agentic tool workflows and constrained MOF generation.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: MANTA: Unlocking DAG Flexibility in Asynchronous BFT
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

DAG-based BFT protocols marked a shift in consensus design by replacing single-leader proposal paths with concurrent block proposals linked through a shared ...

DAG-based BFT protocols marked a shift in consensus design by replacing single-leader proposal paths with concurrent block proposals linked through a shared graph, where references encode consensus evidence. However, under heterogeneous wide-area networks (WANs), existing designs suffer from prolonged rounds and degraded performance due to straggler effects. The root cause is rigid round advancement: replicas move in synchronized rounds, waiting for enough references from the previous round before advancing. We propose a flexible DAG growth framework for asynchronous BFT consensus. Our key observation is that while reference quorums are necessary for safety and liveness, they need not block every round advancement. Instead, the connectivity required for commitment can be accumulated across rounds. Within the framework, we instantiate MANTA, which combines flexible DAG growth to advance by relaxing round synchronization and flexible coin to trigger leader election and finality earlier. Experiments on heterogeneous WAN deployments show that MANTA reduces latency by approximately 30%-70% in our evaluation.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

Diabetic retinopathy grading from retinal fundus photographs is important but difficult to deploy on resource-constrained hardware.

Diabetic retinopathy grading from retinal fundus photographs is important but difficult to deploy on resource-constrained hardware. We conducted a controlled study of offline response-based knowledge distillation for five-class diabetic retinopathy grading on APTOS 2019, comparing ResNet-50, MobileNetV3-Large, and Swin Transformer-Tiny (Swin-T) teachers distilled into a MobileNetV3-Small student. A 3 x 4 x 2 grid of teacher, temperature, and hard-label weight was screened at one seed, while six configurations and the no-distillation baseline were evaluated across three seeds. The highest observed single-seed quadratic weighted kappa was 0.9093 (macro-F1 0.6851) for Swin-T at temperature 4 and hard-label weight 0.7; the corresponding three-seed mean was 0.9024, compared with 0.8804 for the baseline. The student used 1.52 M parameters and 5.94 MB, representing an 18.07x parameter reduction relative to Swin-T. Temperature and hard-label weight effects were teacher- and configuration-dependent, while small performance differences were sensitive to random seed. Kubernetes Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA) is widely used for inference services, but reactive scaling is often too slow when pods take tens of seconds to be...

Kubernetes Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA) is widely used for inference services, but reactive scaling is often too slow when pods take tens of seconds to become ready. The problem gets worse in shared clusters, where independent HPAs compete for the same resource budget and can hurt different tenants from run to run. We present InferScale, a Kubernetes-native autoscaler that combines inference-aware signals, short-horizon demand prediction, SLO-state control, fast-path spike handling, and tenant-priority headroom without replacing the default scheduler. We evaluate InferScale on Azure Kubernetes Service in two settings. On a real ResNet-50 ONNX workload with 21-second cold start, repeated ramp-burst runs improve SLO compliance from 47.8% +/- 1.5% under a stronger external-metric HPA to 65.3% +/- 9.0% under InferScale. In repeated controlled multi-tenant contention experiments, InferScale cuts Gold-tier SLO standard deviation from 16.1 to 1.2 percentage points and makes contention outcomes follow the priority policy more closely. Repeated single-service ablations show 6-8 percentage point degradation, with an exploratory priority ablation showing a 27-point drop under contention. T…

item.title: INTRA: Interleaved Non-contiguous Token spaRse Attention
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

Transformers achieve strong performance across modalities but are bottlenecked by the quadratic cost of attention.

Transformers achieve strong performance across modalities but are bottlenecked by the quadratic cost of attention. Sparse attention can reduce this cost, but effective sparsity must preserve useful long-range communication and map well to GPU hardware. We introduce INTRA--Interleaved Non-contiguous Token spaRse Attention--a hardware-aware static sparse attention design based on a relay-communication view under Computational Query Set (CQS) constraints. Rather than directly covering all token-to-token interactions within each sparse layer, INTRA uses complementary sparse groups to provide short mediated communication paths across layers. Scatter forms relay groups that sample broadly across local neighborhoods, while Gather reconnects these groups in subsequent layers. Under a partition model, this structure guides CQS-compatible sparse patterns with global reachability. Our CQS-aware FlashAttention-style kernel computes structured indices at runtime, loads selected non-contiguous tokens, and packs them densely for computation. item.title: Holding a Steady Course: Knowledge Evolution from Expertise and Lessons for Continual Agent Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

Autonomous agents are increasingly deployed across sequences of related tasks, yet they often fail to retain and improve their knowledge over time.

Autonomous agents are increasingly deployed across sequences of related tasks, yet they often fail to retain and improve their knowledge over time. Existing approaches convert interaction trajectories into memories or reusable skills, but experience is not automatically reliable knowledge. Automatically collected skills and memories can propagate errors, mislead, and corrupt useful knowledge. To address this gap, we introduce Knowledge Evolution from Expertise and Lessons (KEEL), an agent-agnostic framework that uses verifier evidence to transform successful behavior into reusable skills and failures into corrective lessons. As new evidence accumulates, individual skill claims can be supported, contradicted, replaced, or retired. On SkillFlow benchmark, KEEL improves task success by 4.2 to 21.7 percentage points over the no-knowledge baseline, compared with gains of 2.4 to 9.6 points from SkillFlow's default method. Ablations show that skills and lessons are complementary. These results show that reliable continual agent learning depends not simply on accumulating experience, but on continually validating and evolving the knowledge derived from it. item.title: From Human Intent to In-Orbit Action: A Self-Learning Large Language Model Agent for 6G Satellite Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

Autonomous control of sixth-generation (6G) low Earth orbit satellite networks is hindered by the gap between high-level human intent and low-level control l...

Autonomous control of sixth-generation (6G) low Earth orbit satellite networks is hindered by the gap between high-level human intent and low-level control logic: translating a request such as "uninterrupted Arctic video" into a valid reinforcement learning reward still takes days of manual trial and error, and existing large language model translators cannot learn from the failures of the policies they generate. This article presents ALMOND (Agentic Large-Model-Orchestrated autonomous Network Design), a cognitive framework that closes this intent-to-action loop under on-orbit compute constraints. The contribution in artificial intelligence is a bidirectional semantic engine that translates natural-language demands into multi-objective reward functions and, conversely, mines implicit operational constraints from failed reinforcement-learning trajectories through counterfactually validated forensics, together with a large language model-guided graph neuroevolution that seeds and critiques policy architectures. Kernel distances such as the Kernel Inception Distance (KID) and the Kernel Audio Distance (KAD) compare generated and reference samples in an embedding spac...

Kernel distances such as the Kernel Inception Distance (KID) and the Kernel Audio Distance (KAD) compare generated and reference samples in an embedding space, and model comparisons rest on their values. Each ships with one fixed kernel, and a reported value does not say which changes that kernel detects at the sample size used. We run each default as a permutation two-sample test on real embeddings of symbolic music, audio and images, comparing a sample with an independent sample changed by a mean shift, an isotropic contraction, or a rotation that keeps the mean and the covariance trace and is matched to the shift in transport distance. At 780 samples per side, both defaults rarely detect the rotations in five evaluation spaces, while they detect the shifts in every run. The median-bandwidth Gaussian kernel of KAD detects the contraction and regains power against rotations on image embeddings with an order of magnitude more samples. The cubic kernel of KID contains second- and third-moment information but misses the contraction in most runs, and our experiments do not establish a high-power rotation regime for it over the tested sample sizes. item.title: Failure-Resilient and Verifiable Distributed Approximate Nearest-Neighbor Retrieval
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

Distributed vector databases increasingly support security-sensitive applications, yet existing systems primarily protect index integrity or replica availabi...

Distributed vector databases increasingly support security-sensitive applications, yet existing systems primarily protect index integrity or replica availability rather than the trustworthiness of retrieved results. Consequently, a compromised replica can return a plausible but manipulated result that remains cryptographically valid, while conventional replication and Byzantine defenses do not directly establish whether the retrieved results are trustworthy. We present TrustANN, a middleware layer that provides query-level trust for distributed approximate nearest-neighbor (ANN) retrieval without modifying the underlying ANN algorithm. TrustANN introduces three complementary protocols: TrustBind, which verifies retrieval trust from authenticated, consistent, and failure-domain-independent replica evidence; CoordShift, which asynchronously constructs reusable coordination epochs outside the query critical path; and AvailGuard, which performs bounded recovery when replicas are unavailable, stale, or conflicting while preserving the trust criterion. item.title: Execution Logs Sway VLM Judges of Robot Progress
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

Vision-language models now grade robot videos, and text placed beside the frames can change their verdicts.

Vision-language models now grade robot videos, and text placed beside the frames can change their verdicts. On clips where the robot is losing progress, we add one log line saying the robot is making progress. Across Gemini, Qwen and GPT judges, this flips correct verdicts to progress 10 to 35 percentage points more often than a neutral line does. A one-line warning that the log may be wrong removes most of this effect. Selected fake "task complete" claims flip half of Qwen's correct verdicts, against a tenth for unrelated log lines. They have no detectable effect on Gemini.

item.title: Error Diffusion Replaces Latent Weights: Training Binary-Weight Language Models on a Few Bits of Dithered State
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 二值权重 LM 训练需为每权重保留全精度隐式副本与 Adam 状态约 96 额外 bit，部署后的二值模型无法在运行设备上继续适配。

方法 用 2-8 bit 残差缓冲（随机舍入量化）替换隐式权重，训练态从 97 bit/权重降到 3-9 bit；误差扩散优化器把图像半调处理的残差携带循环搬到权重更新路径，缓冲越阈值翻转权重。

关键数字 4-bit 缓冲在二值 MLP 基准上匹配 8-bit；字符级 Transformer（97% 参数二值）2,000 步预算内训练到隐式参考的 5-11%、收敛时 1.7% 内；六个规模上 latent-free 损失在参考的 -2.3% 到 +2.9% 内；设备端续训只需隐式训练态 1/10，融合 CPU kernel 在 275 MB 训练内存预算内完成。

为什么值得看 设备端可继续适配的二值模型训练法，省最多 19x 训练态，边缘持续学习路径。

item.title: Edge-Centric Adaptive Neural Activation via Parametric Tanh Functions
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

Within the broader landscape of artificial intelligence architectures, this paper introduces a compact, edge-centric neural framework that resolves the compu...

Within the broader landscape of artificial intelligence architectures, this paper introduces a compact, edge-centric neural framework that resolves the computational bottlenecks of modern edge-activated paradigms like Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) while retaining their expressiveness over traditional Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs). While KANs demonstrate remarkable representational capacity by placing learnable univariate functions on connection edges rather than hidden nodes, their reliance on non-local B-splines introduces severe optimization hurdles, high memory overhead, and poor hardware scaling. To bridge this gap, we propose the Parametric Tanh Connection Function, a smooth, bounded architectural primitive defined as $a_{\tanh}(x;δ,α,β,γ) = δ+ α\tanh(βx + γ)$. This formulation unifies offset, amplitude, local slope, and horizontal displacement into a lightweight, 4-parameter differentiable mapping optimized edge-by-edge via backpropagation. Evaluated on dense architectures using MNIST and CIFAR-10, our parametric tanh connection model achieves significant absolute accuracy gains over traditional affine baselines-reaching 95.63% $\pm$ 0.08% on MNIST and 44.74% $\pm$ 0.18%…

item.title: Dynamic Multi-Step Decoding for Time-Series Foundation Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

Time-series forecasting models typically use a fixed decoding strategy at inference time: either one-shot prediction of the full horizon or autoregressive ro...

Time-series forecasting models typically use a fixed decoding strategy at inference time: either one-shot prediction of the full horizon or autoregressive rollout over atomic chunks. While one-shot decoding reduces error accumulation, it can discard useful sequential structure; conversely, autoregressive decoding preserves temporal dependencies but may compound errors. We argue that the optimal decoding strategy is not fixed across inputs, but should be selected adaptively for each forecasting instance. We propose a dynamic strategy selector that treats the forecast rollout schedule as an inference-time decision problem for frozen pretrained time-series foundation models. The selector is a learned network that ranks candidate rollout schedules using hidden states of the backbone, and is trained on historical windows of the evaluated tasks for each backbone. To make the candidate set tractable over the exponentially large space of horizon partitions, we use dynamic programming that reduces candidate evaluation to quadratic complexity while preserving much of the oracle gain. At deployment, five independently trained selectors vote on each decision, and the policy follows their conse…

item.title: DoubleFree:Exploiting Exploration History for Rollout-Free Multi-Task LLMs Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

Multi-task post-training can develop domain specialists through independent reinforcement learning (RL) and consolidate their capabilities through multi-teac...

Multi-task post-training can develop domain specialists through independent reinforcement learning (RL) and consolidate their capabilities through multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). However, standard MOPD generates on-policy student responses and keeps multiple teachers online throughout consolidation, introducing substantial system costs. We view this pipeline as domain-wise exploration followed by cross-domain exploitation. Domain RL produces not only the final specialists, but also the trajectories collected throughout their training. Existing methods primarily use the former while leaving the latter underutilized. We introduce DoubleFree, which reuses these historical trajectories for rollout-free consolidation and precomputes teacher supervision for online-teacher-free student training. To understand why this works, we analyze when updates from historical trajectories can approximate on-policy distillation updates and how combining trajectories across exploration stages can better support an evolving student. DoubleFree requires only minimal changes to existing post-training frameworks. Across math, code, and instruction following on Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and SmolLM3-3…

Domain RL produces not only the final specialists, but also the trajectories collected throughout their training. Existing methods primarily use the former while leaving the latter underutilized. We introduce DoubleFree, which reuses these historical trajectories for rollout-free consolidation and precomputes teacher supervision for online-teacher-free student training. To understand why this works, we analyze when updates from historical trajectories can approximate on-policy distillation updates and how combining trajectories across exploration stages can better support an evolving student. item.title: Do Bio-Inspired Algorithms Save Energy in Data Centres? Separating Server Packing from Migration Search in Virtual Machine Consolidation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

Energy-efficient virtual machine (VM) consolidation matters as data centre electricity demand rises.

Energy-efficient virtual machine (VM) consolidation matters as data centre electricity demand rises. Bio-inspired metaheuristics, including ant colony optimisation (ACO), particle swarm optimisation (PSO), and genetic algorithms, have reported substantial energy savings. However, these improvements are commonly evaluated against conventional allocation policies that differ in both initial VM placement and subsequent migration optimisation, making it difficult to determine the contribution of metaheuristic search. This study reproduces an existing consolidation implementation in CloudSim Plus and introduces a matched control that retains the same initial packing and empty-host deactivation mechanisms but excludes migration search. ACO, PSO, and a modified genetic algorithm (MGA) are evaluated across two fleet configurations and four workload regimes, with ten stochastic replications per condition. The matched control achieves energy savings of 0.8-81.4% relative to the spreading baseline, the amount available falling sharply as load rises, without migrations or incomplete workload execution. item.title: Distributed LLM Inference via Communication-Efficient Speculative Decoding
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 分布式投机解码中，设备-服务器间传输完整词表分布是带宽受限环境的主要开销——能否消除词表级通信而不破坏精确目标分布？

方法 DISCO：服务器侧复制一份草稿小模型，使服务器本地即可获得拒绝采样所需分布；设备与服务器间只交换草稿 token 索引与标量概率值。

关键数字 摘要未给出统一量化数字；多数据集实验显示 DISCO 解码加速持续高于既有方法，严格带宽约束下差距更明显。

为什么值得看 用"服务器侧草稿副本"免去词表级传输，直击端-云协同推理带宽痛点。

item.title: Decoupled Prune-and-Reconstruct: Training on a Compact Core with Double-Layer Sparsification
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

On million-node graphs, the memory wall arrives before the compute wall: a GNN that never fits in VRAM cannot deliver the all-node inference its accuracy pro...

On million-node graphs, the memory wall arrives before the compute wall: a GNN that never fits in VRAM cannot deliver the all-node inference its accuracy promises. The standard remedy, pruning, has always been an accuracy tax - paid once and never refunded. DPR refuses this framing. Its central insight is that the mask that shrinks training can also scaffold recovery: one compact node set bounds both computations of graph learning, serving as the encoder's training graph and, at inference, as the anchor from which a sparse structure-aware decoder rebuilds every pruned node (double-layer sparsification). The order is inverted - prune for efficiency, then reconstruct for accuracy - and the tax is repaid: the deployed 30%-budget model trains in 1,450 MiB of peak memory on one 6 GB GPU and recovers 96.9% of its dense-reconstruction reference, beating a same-GPU rerun of the edge-sparsification baseline DSpar by +1.36 pp at 50.1% lower peak training memory; against the same-protocol full-batch no-prune encoder the deployed point pays a measured 2.64 pp accuracy tax for a 2.8x smaller training footprint. Pruning without reconstruction leaves the encoder at 0.378 within the same 40-epoch …
