The sampling procedures of diffusion and flow-matching models involve hundreds of denoising steps incurring substantial inference time, which has motivated a...

The sampling procedures of diffusion and flow-matching models involve hundreds of denoising steps incurring substantial inference time, which has motivated a growing body of work on training schemes for few-step and one-step generation. Existing approaches primarily seek to align the generation trajectory of few-step and base models, yet their training objectives only involve discrepancies at a single point in the trajectory, encouraging only local \emph{point-level} alignment. While recent methods such as \emph{Shortcut-CSL} introduce cumulative objective that enforce alignment over the entire trajectory, this is suboptimal as they do not directly enforce alignment between the distributions induced by the two models throughout the generation process. item.title: Cross-Modal Data Co-Locality for Heterogeneous Storage Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

Distributed vector stores increasingly serve multimodal workloads whose representations are jointly accessed but independently partitioned and placed.

Distributed vector stores increasingly serve multimodal workloads whose representations are jointly accessed but independently partitioned and placed. As a result, cross-modal physical locality remains largely unoptimized. Multimodal queries can incur remote accesses and cross-tier data movement even when each modality's ANN search remains efficient. We present Coloc, a storage-management layer that makes cross-modal access locality a first-class data-layout signal. A Cross-Modal Access Graph combines semantic affinity, co-access, and temporal behavior. A movement-aware optimizer places frequently co-accessed vectors under capacity and topology constraints. A migration manager adapts placement as workloads shift by weighing locality gains against migration cost. A confidence-gated prefetcher hides remaining slow-tier latency. Coloc operates above existing ANN indexes without modifying embeddings, search, or retrieval semantics. We deploy Coloc on a multi-tier AWS testbed spanning GPU, NUMA-DRAM, NVMe, and S3. Coloc substantially reduces data movement and query latency while leaving ANN retrieval unchanged. Under a scheduled workload shift, its migration manager matches the locality…

item.title: Cross-Loop Query Handoff: How Later Loops Redirect Two-Hop Retrieval in the Ouro Looped Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

How do later loops in a pretrained looped language model repair two-hop retrieval? We study Ouro-1.4B and Ouro-2.6B by transplanting attention queries betwee...

How do later loops in a pretrained looped language model repair two-hop retrieval? We study Ouro-1.4B and Ouro-2.6B by transplanting attention queries between loops at the same layer, head and final prompt position. On synthetic in-context questions, injecting the layer-indexed collection of loop-3 queries throughout loop 1 rescues 90% and 97% of questions answered incorrectly at loop 1 and correctly at loop 3, versus 24% and 21% for shuffled donors. The rescue also holds under greedy generation in Ouro-2.6B; in Ouro-1.4B it is limited to four-candidate ranking. Crossed donor-recipient swaps favor retrieval through the donor's bridge entity over copying its answer, although a substantial positional component remains in Ouro-2.6B. Late keys and values rescue far fewer targets. Freezing queries at their loop-1 values also damages two-hop accuracy more than a matched question that supplies the bridge. On natural questions, rescue is smaller and replicates only in Ouro-2.6B, and crossed swaps do not establish bridge redirection. These results identify a transferable collection of late-loop queries that supports bridge-conditioned retrieval on synthetic scenes; they do not locate where …

item.title: Continual Learning Exam: Benchmarking Long-Horizon RSI and Experiential Learning in LLM Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

Continual learning is the ability of LLM agents to improve over time by acquiring, refining, and applying knowledge from experience while retaining useful pr...

Continual learning is the ability of LLM agents to improve over time by acquiring, refining, and applying knowledge from experience while retaining useful prior knowledge. It is essential for agents learning over long time horizons, yet current evaluations largely assess individual task performance rather than improvement through accumulated experience. We introduce Continual Learning Exam (CLE), a large-scale benchmark developed by 50+ domain experts to measure experience-driven improvement in realistic professional workflows. CLE comprises 120 human-authored tasks, each organised as a five-level ladder, yielding 600 levels spanning 89 professional roles across 12 occupational domains. Agents must pass each level to unlock the next, with later levels building on experience accumulated during earlier assignments. An evaluation agent assesses each submission against human-authored rubrics. We compare a single-submission setting with one that provides diagnostic feedback after failure and allows one revision. Across 17 harness-model configurations using frontier LLMs, feedback and revision yield a median completion gain of 5.3 percentage points. Yet the best-performing system clears …

item.title: Conditional Diffusion Generation of DVL and Inertial Signals for Underwater Navigation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) navigate without satellite positioning and rely on Doppler velocity log (DVL) and inertial sensors for motion estimation.

Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) navigate without satellite positioning and rely on Doppler velocity log (DVL) and inertial sensors for motion estimation. Deep learning methods for processing these sensors require training data covering the motion the AUV encounters, commonly obtained through costly sea trials. To overcome this limitation, we present a conditional diffusion framework that generates synthetic DVL and inertial signals to replace real recordings in training. The generator employs an Elucidated diffusion model conditioned on three per-channel motion descriptors. Three configurations are evaluated: DVL beams alone, inertial channels alone, and all channels jointly from one model. Across thirteen trajectories of the real dataset, the generated signals followed the requested conditions with Pearson correlations between 0.72 and 0.997, transferred to trajectories withheld from generator training, and did not replicate any training window. A BeamsNet velocity estimator trained on generated signals alone, with no real recording retained, matched the velocity error obtained with the full real training set. item.title: ChroNoC: A Tableless TDM Circuit-Switched NoC With Delay-Aware Deployment for Time-Sensitive Neuromorphic Computing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 时间敏感神经形态架构需要可预测互连以保持事件时序；静态调度 TDM 电路交换 NoC 确定性好但配置内存随调度深度线性增长，且任务放置/路由/调度联合优化不可解。

方法 ChroNoC 是无表 TDM NoC，把预计算的全网格广播树嵌入组合逻辑作固定路由基底；DARSA 将轴突延迟转为周期性调度松弛、错峰注入以降低通信开销，把部署简化为空间搜索。

关键数字 130nm CMOS 下每跳能耗较电路/包交换基线降超 75%；UCI-HAR 与 N-MNIST 上 DARSA 使每时间步通信周期约降 60% 与 45%，并减少预配通信内存。

为什么值得看 轻量 TDM 开关+延迟感知部署的软硬件协同，兼顾神经事件时序与通信效率。

item.title: BriLLM-MetaPred: A Representation-Prediction Unity Language Model with Adaptive Self-Measurement
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

We present BriLLM-MetaPred, the first engineering implementation of the MetaPred machine-learning framework established by a mathematical theory of AGI, inst...

We present BriLLM-MetaPred, the first engineering implementation of the MetaPred machine-learning framework established by a mathematical theory of AGI, instantiated for language modeling. The theory argues that MetaPred is both necessary and sufficient as a machine-learning primitive for general cognition. Taking this theoretical conclusion as a design premise, we report an implementation of the primitive for language modeling. A single continuously evolving dynamical state serves as both the context representation and the state from which predictions are read out. Continuous measurement of its own state reduces finite-depth inconsistency, maintains internal consistency, and provides an endogenous dynamical self-supervision signal in fixed-point form. The single dynamical state of MetaPred intrinsically couples training and inference. MetaPred therefore exhibits symmetry across almost all key elements of machine learning, an intuitive and observable property of the mathematical optimum over the space of all machine-learning paradigms. BriLLM-MetaPred is neither another recurrent language model nor an extension of BriLLM. It provides a bridge between two prior contributions: the co…

item.title: AndroidFlux: Evaluating and Reward Modeling Failure Recovery Capabilities in Mobile Use Multimodal Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-25　分类：论文PDF

Mobile-use multimodal agents are typically evaluated by task success from a clean initial state, which does not isolate their ability to recover from interme...

Mobile-use multimodal agents are typically evaluated by task success from a clean initial state, which does not isolate their ability to recover from intermediate errors. Because mobile environments change dynamically, a general mobile-use agent must complete tasks robustly even from unexpected states and in unseen environments. This requires knowing when and where an agent makes errors, and whether it can recover from errors and subsequent states. To evaluate this capability, we introduce AndroidFlux, a failure-recovery benchmark built on AndroidWorld. AndroidFlux restores recorded trajectories to controlled checkpoints before, at, and after the first recoverable error, so that different agents continue from the same device state and history. On these checkpoints, a complementary reward-modeling benchmark evaluates recovery-action preferences using downstream rollout outcomes. We further release an offline reinforcement learning (RL) dataset that improves both error recovery and overall task success. Our evaluations show that recovery performance only partially correlates with clean-start success, and that explicit reasoning helps only models trained with GUI-domain specific RL.

Mobile-use multimodal agents are typically evaluated by task success from a clean initial state, which does not isolate their ability to recover from interme...

Mobile-use multimodal agents are typically evaluated by task success from a clean initial state, which does not isolate their ability to recover from intermediate errors. Because mobile environments change dynamically, a general mobile-use agent must complete tasks robustly even from unexpected states and in unseen environments. This requires knowing when and where an agent makes errors, and whether it can recover from errors and subsequent states. To evaluate this capability, we introduce AndroidFlux, a failure-recovery benchmark built on AndroidWorld. AndroidFlux restores recorded trajectories to controlled checkpoints before, at, and after the first recoverable error, so that different agents continue from the same device state and history. On these checkpoints, a complementary reward-modeling benchmark evaluates recovery-action preferences using downstream rollout outcomes. We further release an offline reinforcement learning (RL) dataset that improves both error recovery and overall task success. Our evaluations show that recovery performance only partially correlates with clean-start success, and that explicit reasoning helps only models trained with GUI-domain specific RL.

item.title: llama.cpp b11868: hexagon KV-head team split for multicore HMX flash attention (#31055)
item.description:
发表方：llama.cpp（GitHub Releases）　发布：2026-10-24　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题：llama.cpp b11868——Hexagon 后端为 HMX flash attention 引入 KV-head team split。 要点：合并 FA_HEAD_SPLIT 与 FA_SPLIT 为单一开关：0 仅 token split、1 为 head-split 并在 KV head 少于核数时附加 team-split。 关键数字：示例 gemma-4 仅 2 个 KV head 跑 4 核，team-split 让闲置核参与。 为什么值得看：解决 KV head 少于核数致核闲置的场景，把多核并行扩展到 team 协作，提升端侧推理利用率。

item.title: ZipFusion: Fusing Lossless KV Decompression with Attention for Efficient LLM Decoding
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 无损 KV 压缩方法通常在 GPU 内存中还原后再做 attention，重复 KV 读取与解压开销仍在，解码仍受内存带宽限制。

方法 ZipFusion 让 attention 直接消费无损压缩 KV：协同设计压缩格式与 attention kernel，kernel 用寄存器内简单位运算重建原值，免去单独解压 pass 并缓解带宽瓶颈；压缩释放的内存跨层重分配以存储更多 KV。

关键数字 H100 上解码 attention 较 FlashInfer 约 1.25x 加速；8K 上下文、同 GPU 内存预算下模型解码吞吐最多提升 26.3%；各方法最大支持批下吞吐达最佳无损压缩基线的 2.76x。

为什么值得看 无损 KV 压缩与 attention 融合的工程路线，直接缓解解码带宽瓶颈。

item.title: When is early stopping beneficial under label noise? A phase diagram for kernel gradient flow
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Early stopping is commonly used to prevent fitting label noise from degrading generalization.

Early stopping is commonly used to prevent fitting label noise from degrading generalization. Does this mean that, when a positive fraction of the training labels is intrinsically unpredictable, the best test error must occur before interpolation? Experiments on a CIFAR10 classification task with randomly labeled examples motivate the opposite possibility: although fixed-feature and shallow models exhibit late-time deterioration of the test error, the need for early stopping essentially disappears in larger, deeper convolutional networks even after the random labels have all been classified correctly. We determine when late-time deterioration disappears entirely in a solvable setting. For kernel gradient flow on a synthetic noisy classification task, we derive sharp high-dimensional learning curves and obtain a phase diagram controlled by the balance between the linear kernel component that learns the shared relation between inputs and labels and the higher-order components that enable fitting the label noise. In one regime, generalization is optimized at finite time and early stopping is necessary. In another, generalization improves until interpolation, but the endpoint is subopt…

item.title: The Analytical Investigation of Inductor-Coupled Mixers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Inductor- and transformer-coupled balanced mixers are usually analyzed with switching approximations, conversion matrices, harmonic balance, or circuit simul...

Inductor- and transformer-coupled balanced mixers are usually analyzed with switching approximations, conversion matrices, harmonic balance, or circuit simulation. This paper instead derives their loaded quasistatic equations from the device laws, keeping the transformer ratios, reflected load, bias, and the connections that set the IF common mode. The functions needed to solve these equations are surprisingly varied. A Shockley single-balanced pair is solved by the principal Lambert function $W_0$ under a quantified one-diode-dominance condition. The double-balanced ring has a unique loaded solution that reduces to an exact inverse-hyperbolic-tangent form only for an open IF port. Vacuum diodes and triodes lead to Cardano cubics and structured sextics, whereas depletion JFET/MESFET crossbars need only square roots. Bilateral MOS channels give piecewise quadratics in strong inversion, or a Ferrari quartic when the IF winding floats. In weak inversion they give an exact $W_0$, the real $r$-Lambert function, or the inverse of $\sinh x+ρx$, depending on topology and IF connection. In matched BJT and HBT Gilbert cells, equal emitter resistors turn the hyperbolic-tangent current steerin…

item.title: Speeding up Log-Sum-Exp: Kernel Fusion at the Memory Wall, Integer Arithmetic at the Compute Wall
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

While the Log-Sum-Exp (LSE) function is a foundational numerical primitive for stable log-domain computation in modern machine learning, its fast and efficie...

While the Log-Sum-Exp (LSE) function is a foundational numerical primitive for stable log-domain computation in modern machine learning, its fast and efficient computation on generic platforms (\ie, CPUs and GPUs) has been underexplored, potentially creating execution bottlenecks for large workloads. On GPU, the de facto implementation $\texttt{torch.logsumexp}$ dispatches a chain of nine sub-kernels per call, incurring redundant High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) traffic and launch overhead. On CPU, exp and log operations are hardware-hungry, limiting the computing efficiency. To address these bottlenecks, we propose two drop-in kernels to significantly accelerate LSE computation on both GPUs and CPUs: FuseLSE, a single-pass fused kernel that evaluates LSE's exp and log functions on the GPU's Special Function Unit (SFU); and IntLSE, which further replaces the LSE computation with approximated integer arithmetic for CPU computation. Our experiments, validated by benchmarks across workload sizes and hardware platforms, show that both kernels are ${\sim}10-11\times$ faster than PyTorch at small workloads and ${\sim}6\times$ faster on larger ones on GPUs, where the speed-up is attributed to …

item.title: Sliding Networks: A Family of Residual Structures Preserving Feature Learning and Feature Diversity
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Deep learning models tend to perform best at large widths and depths.

Deep learning models tend to perform best at large widths and depths. The growing interest in scaling laws, especially in the language modeling domain, has motivated procedures for scaling up network widths and depths in order to preserve stability and computational efficiency of training dynamics. Existing depth-scaling approaches force a choice between retaining locally maximal \emph{feature learning} and preserving a form of \emph{feature diversity} in the residual stream arising from random differences between channels. We examine a \textit{joint scaling recipe} that preserves both. With residual width $N_\flat$, hidden width $N_\sharp$, and depth $L$, the key quantity is, by default, the limiting ratio $N_\flat/(N_\sharp L)\toα$, while correlated initialization (Half Copy) can partially relax the resulting shape constraints. Theory and residual-MLP experiments support convergence at fixed positive $α$ to an SDE limit with locally maximal feature learning. Hidden computations can then be redistributed between width and depth while preserving this limit, like turning melody into harmony and back. item.title: Satellite-derived bathymetry of Arabian Gulf ports under leakage-free validation: a multi-site benchmark of empirical, machine-learning and deep-learning models against 285,000 multibeam soundings, with an outlook for UAE waters
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Satellite-derived bathymetry (SDB) is often proposed as a low-cost complement to multibeam surveys of ports, but its accuracy is seldom measured on an area t...

Satellite-derived bathymetry (SDB) is often proposed as a low-cost complement to multibeam surveys of ports, but its accuracy is seldom measured on an area the model has never seen. We test SDB in the turbid, shallow and tidal waters of the Abu Dhabi coast against 285,619 multibeam soundings from twelve surveys at six port areas, reduced to Lowest Astronomical Tide. The Stumpf ratio, the Lyzenga transform, a monotonic gradient-boosted tree model (LightGBM) and a U-Net ensemble were trained on 72 Sentinel-2 images and tested in transfer to an unseen site and with local control (about 20% of a site's soundings, spatial blocks beyond a 225 m buffer). The validation design changed the result more than the model: the same LightGBM model gave 0.57 m RMSE under a random pixel split, 1.30 m under spatial blocks and 1.66 m at an unseen site. In transfer the Stumpf ratio (1.45 m) was not beaten by LightGBM, the U-Net or Lyzenga. With local control a hybrid of the tree output and the band ratio reached 1.11 m over 0-11 m, 67% of pixels within the IHO S-44 Order 2 tolerance and a conformal 95% interval with 95% observed coverage; in clear water it reached 0.29-0.53 m. item.title: Replicate What Varies: Resource Sharing for Domain-Randomized Embodied Simulation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Simulation provides a low-cost sandbox where embodied agents can attempt tasks, observe outcomes, and learn from experience.

Simulation provides a low-cost sandbox where embodied agents can attempt tasks, observe outcomes, and learn from experience. Running many diverse simulation environments concurrently can consume substantial CPU and GPU memory because independently constructed scenes duplicate resources that remain unchanged across instances. We present Patchwork, a resource-sharing system for domain-randomized simulation, built around the representation $E=T+Δ$: a shared template contains common resources, and a patch records the mutations needed to construct a target environment. Patchwork separates randomization sampling from replay and selects reusable templates together with patches that preserve each target environment's intended configuration. Its layered runtime shares compiled model structure and immutable assets while keeping mutable parameters and simulation state private to each instance. We implement Patchwork on robosuite and MuJoCo and evaluate it on LIBERO-plus and RoboCasa365 workloads. At 32 replicas, shared-template execution reduces CPU RSS by 88-92% relative to process-per-environment execution. Controlled experiments show how sharing shifts memory growth toward template diversi…

item.title: Real-Time Recurrent Qubit-State Discrimination on a Heterogeneous AI-Engine-FPGA Accelerator
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Qubit readout, or qubit state discrimination, remains one of the slowest and most error-prone operations in superconducting quantum processors, making fast, ...

Qubit readout, or qubit state discrimination, remains one of the slowest and most error-prone operations in superconducting quantum processors, making fast, accurate, and hardware-efficient classification essential for scalable quantum computing. Conventional discriminators integrate the I/Q record into a single point, discarding evidence a relaxing qubit leaves behind; full-resolution feed-forward classifiers recover it but are too costly to deploy under this constraint. Recurrent classifiers retain full resolution far more cheaply, but their loop-carried hidden state cannot fit a single AI Engine (AIE) tile's register capacity and spills to data memory, adding latency that grows with sequence length. We present a hardware-aware LSTM accelerator for an AMD Versal device that resolves this by partitioning at the dependency boundary - independent input projections on the AIE array, the loop-carried update in programmable logic (PL) - keeping pace with a 64 ns input cadence under a 1,000 ns budget. item.title: Queuing for Inference: Dynamic Memory Footprints and Costly Preemption
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.PF)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Modeling inference workloads for transformer-based neural networks poses unique challenges due to their dynamic memory footprints, head-of-line blocking caus...

Modeling inference workloads for transformer-based neural networks poses unique challenges due to their dynamic memory footprints, head-of-line blocking caused by heavy-tailed request distributions, and memory-dependent preemption overhead arising from the need to load/unload cache state. In this paper, we introduce a new queuing model that captures the impacts of these features on system stability and scheduling design. We show that the Gittins-index policy, which minimizes mean response time in the standard M/G/1 setting, can incur substantial preemption overhead in our model. Motivated by this limitation, we propose the Multi-Level-Priority-Threshold (MLPT) policy, that limits preemption while preserving priority for short jobs. We characterize the mean response time under MLPT and provide empirical rules-of-thumb to solve the resulting threshold-optimization problem. Our key observation is that optimal scheduling is a balance between reducing the response times of shorter jobs and limiting the overhead incurred when preemption occurs. These results provide a theoretical framework for understanding scheduling in memory constrained queuing systems for inference tasks.

item.title: Operating System Support for Accelerators as First-Class Compute Elements in Heterogeneous Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Heterogeneous systems-on-chip (SoCs) increasingly rely on domain-specific hardware accelerators (HAs) to deliver performance and energy efficiency gains beyo...

Heterogeneous systems-on-chip (SoCs) increasingly rely on domain-specific hardware accelerators (HAs) to deliver performance and energy efficiency gains beyond what general-purpose processors can provide. However, operating systems (O/S), such as Linux, assume that processors are the Compute Elements (CEs) and HAs are peripheral devices rather than specialized CEs. As a result, HA execution incurs substantial software (SW) overheads that reduce the effective benefits of hardware (HW) acceleration. This work demonstrates that significant inefficiencies arise from ``O/S peripheral device taxes'' (O/S taxes), including SW stack-accelerator communication, invocation, interrupt handling, and scheduling. We built MEERKAT, a Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA)-based framework for configurable multicore systems that include HAs; it allows the user to migrate Linux O/S support from SW to HW and identify, study, and quantify the impact. Here we study four major sources of O/S tax and introduce techniques to mitigate them. These include a virtual-memory-aware (VMA) communication method that enables efficient HA access to application data, a lightweight HA invocation interface, Interrupt Poli…

item.title: One Call Ahead: Packed Self-Speculative Decoding with Diffusion Drafting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Autoregressive (AR) language models generate tokens sequentially, so generating long outputs is costly.

Autoregressive (AR) language models generate tokens sequentially, so generating long outputs is costly. Speculative decoding mitigates this by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple tokens for the target AR model to verify in parallel, while a diffusion-based drafter can produce an entire draft block in one forward pass. In models with AR and diffusion modes, one network both drafts and verifies, but drafting still waits for verification, so the standard schedule needs two sequential model calls per iteration. Existing one-call schedules avoid the wait but incur input size quadratic in the speculative width. Motivated by this efficiency bottleneck, we introduce Packed-SS, a self-speculative decoding schedule that verifies and drafts in a single model call with input size linear in the speculative width, while preserving the target model's distribution. The key idea is to let the diffusion drafter run one call ahead: while verifying the current draft, the model simultaneously constructs the next draft from an older verified prefix and keeps its unresolved suffix for the next iteration. Under a mild monotonicity assumption on the drafter, we further show that Packed-SS requi…

item.title: Min-Marginal Power Indices for Multi-Objective Feature Selection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Game-theoretic feature selection scores each feature by its average marginal contribution across coalitions.

Game-theoretic feature selection scores each feature by its average marginal contribution across coalitions. An average shows whether a feature helps overall, but not whether, in some coalition, adding it turns an acceptable model into an unacceptable one. Building on minimum marginal aggregation, we define the Min-Marginal Power Index (MinPI) on a binary utility-threshold game. For a fixed quota, MinPI takes the value -1, 0, or +1 and labels each feature harmful, neutral, or decisive. A harmful label carries its own evidence, an evaluated coalition in which adding the feature drops utility below the quota, so no score cutoff is needed; finite-budget estimators keep this property but may miss harmful features. We use MinPI to propose feature removals, which are accepted only if they pass a validation gate, and to prefilter multi-objective search. On six benchmark datasets over five seeds, MinPI removed 12.5% of analyzed features with almost no loss of held-out utility. On Madelon and Abalone, where it removed the most, its removals cost far less held-out utility than random removals of the same size. Prefiltering increased the dataset-averaged hypervolume of multi-objective search …

item.title: Memory or a Clock? Auditing a Memory Advantage in XLand-MiniGrid with Seeds, Maps and Evaluation Noise Apart
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

On a partially observable XLand-MiniGrid task, an LSTM agent beats a memory-free MLP by 25 percentage points.

On a partially observable XLand-MiniGrid task, an LSTM agent beats a memory-free MLP by 25 percentage points. The gap looks like a clear case of memory. We ask two questions about it. First, how much of a measured gap is noise? Separating training seed, map and evaluation randomness in 60 runs, each re-evaluated three times, we find that about ten paired seeds detect a 10-point gap in final success. The binary "task acquired" verdict, a common summary of learning curves, is 76% evaluation noise and would need about a hundred seeds for the same gap. Second, is the gap memory? On a sealed panel of new maps, opened once, a memory-free MLP of the LSTM's size comes within 3.3 points of the LSTM when it is given the time step, and gains no measurable benefit from its width without it. With the time step, an MLP a quarter of the LSTM's size, and the LSTM with its state erased at every step, also come within about 5 points. A linear probe reads the time step from the trained LSTM's state. On this task, most of the apparent memory advantage is an advantage of knowing the time, which matters because episodes are cut at a fixed limit and the reward shrinks with time. item.title: Learning What to Share: Expert Specialization for Time-Series Forecasting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

A central challenge in multivariate forecasting is deciding what to share across channels and where to specialize.

A central challenge in multivariate forecasting is deciding what to share across channels and where to specialize. Mixture-of-experts models offer flexible sharing, yet it remains unclear how much of their forecasting gains comes from added capacity or expert allocation. Through controlled comparisons across eleven datasets and three backbones, we show that informative channel assignments improve forecasting beyond matched shared capacity and random allocation. On frozen transformer backbones, persistent channel-specific mixtures outperform input-dependent routing on average. To examine when and how much specialization helps, we introduce GalaxyTS, a controlled synthetic dataset with exact shared and channel-specific forecasting references. It reveals how persistent channel mixtures exploit predictive differences concealed by short input windows and measures gains over matched shared corrections. These insights motivate Persistent Closed-Form Routing (PCR), a plug-and-play method that alternates exact conditional estimation of channel-specific mixture weights with gradient-based training of low-rank residual experts around a frozen pretrained forecaster. item.title: LLMs in Cloud: A Discussion on Architecture, Orchestration, and Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

The widespread deployment of foundational Large Language Models (LLM) across cloud datacenters marks a fundamental paradigm shift from stateless deep learnin...

The widespread deployment of foundational Large Language Models (LLM) across cloud datacenters marks a fundamental paradigm shift from stateless deep learning toward distributed, memory-intensive generative workloads. However, serving massive foundation models under stringent Service Level Objectives (SLO) exposes critical physical and system bottlenecks. These challenges include the persistent High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) wall, operational asymmetry between compute-bound prefilling and memory-bandwidth-bound decoding, explosive Key-Value (KV) cache expansion, prohibitive serverless cold starts, and hardware reliability vulnerabilities. Existing literature reviews remain layer-siloed, decoupling low-level accelerator virtualization from cluster orchestration and runtime inference, while largely overlooking defining advancements from 2024 to 2026. To address these limitations, this study presents a comprehensive, cross-layer systematic review guided by the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) 2020 framework. We synthesize a holistic taxonomy unifying hardware virtualization, cluster-level scheduling, and runtime inference optimizations, includin…

item.title: H-GLow: Accelerating Graph Generation via Hazard-Guided Discrete Flow Matching
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Discrete flow matching (DFM) offers a promising approach to graph generation; however, generating high-quality graphs with few steps remains challenging due ...

Discrete flow matching (DFM) offers a promising approach to graph generation; however, generating high-quality graphs with few steps remains challenging due to the strong dependencies between nodes and edges. Although DFM decouples training from sampling, enabling flexible sampling strategies without retraining, existing graph DFM samplers often rely on task-specific heuristics, substantially expanding the hyperparameter space. Moreover, graph DFM models still require sampling budgets comparable to those of diffusion-based approaches, leaving their potential for accelerating graph generation only partially realized. In this work, we introduce H-Glow, a hazard-guided framework for accelerating graph generation built on the decomposition of Continuous-Time Markov chain (CTMC) generators into hazards and conditional jump distributions. H-Glow leverages these quantities to plan graph edits and dynamically adjust the sampling time to graph activity. H-Glow can be adapted to pretrained graph DFM models, substantially improving the generation quality with fewer steps. We further introduce a novel graph DFM model based on the conditional generator matching framework, which directly predict…

item.title: Geodesic-SVDD Latent Mixup for One-Shot Distributed Tabular Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Distributed Learning on structured data is a key and widely adopted approach in privacy-sensitive sectors, ranging from financial fraud prevention to federat...

Distributed Learning on structured data is a key and widely adopted approach in privacy-sensitive sectors, ranging from financial fraud prevention to federated healthcare diagnostics. While Gradient Boosted Decision Trees are widely used in centralized settings due to their efficiency, they are incompatible with standard gradient-based federated learning protocols because of their non-differentiability. Conversely, standard deep classifiers that are amenable to federated optimization often suffer from catastrophic forgetting under label distribution skew. In this work, to address these gaps we propose Geodesic-SVDD, a framework for Distributed Spherical Prototype Learning that recasts each client's task as one-class density estimation on the hypersphere, so that local models can be aggregated as probabilistic manifolds in a single round. Specifically, for each client, we employ a Residual Spherical Encoder and Geodesic Latent Mixup that enforces strict hyperspherical constraints ($\|φ(x)\| \equiv 1$), preventing the manifold collapse observed in linear approximations. Furthermore, leveraging this insight, we propose a novel One-Shot "Product of Experts" protocol that enables privac…

item.title: FedSEAM: Federated Continual Learning of LLMs via Subspace Expert Agreement Merging
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Federated continual learning trains a model on a sequence of tasks across several clients without sharing their data while retaining knowledge of earlier tasks.

Federated continual learning trains a model on a sequence of tasks across several clients without sharing their data while retaining knowledge of earlier tasks. Sparse mixture-of-experts models support this setting by adapting selected parameters on a frozen backbone. However, clients learn different expert content as tasks evolve, making it difficult to share knowledge across clients without disrupting task-specific and client-specific specialization. Matching tile coordinates alone does not establish whether their learned content is compatible. We present FedSEAM, a federated continual learning framework that organizes task knowledge into sparse experts and selectively shares their content across tasks and clients. On each client, task-aware tile selection allocates capacity to a new task, while a subspace-based compatibility test determines which existing expert tiles to reuse and where to introduce fresh capacity. On the server, Subspace Expert Agreement Merging (SEAM) compares client updates as subspaces and moves each client towards consensus only along agreed-upon directions, leaving the rest of its update unchanged. We identify two remaining sources of forgetting, routing d…

item.title: FastSAR: High-Throughput, High-Fidelity Open-Source SAR Image Formation on CPUs, GPUs and TPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.PF)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Exact backprojection of a spaceborne SAR collection needs one interpolated read per pixel for every pulse; for the 12,207 by 8,808 pixel Umbra image of the P...

Exact backprojection of a spaceborne SAR collection needs one interpolated read per pixel for every pulse; for the 12,207 by 8,808 pixel Umbra image of the Panama Canal this balloons to 1.6 trillion reads. FastSAR is an open-source library for SAR image formation on CPUs, NVIDIA GPUs and Google TPUs, with factorized backprojection, exact backprojection and polar format behind one Python interface and readers for the vendors' phase-history files. Its factorized kernels form the Panama image in 11.2 s on a 16-vCPU instance, 3.0 s on an NVIDIA L4, 0.6 s on an H100 and 2.9 s on a TPU v6e, with errors of -56 to -63 dB relative to a float64 exact backprojection in three regions over six cloud devices; the L4, a modest GPU, gives the lowest cost of the six at 0.59 US dollars per thousand images. At exact backprojection FastSAR is as fast as the MatX backprojection example, by far the fastest open-source implementation found (10.9 against 11.6 s at the same accuracy, with MatX's pixel coordinates in float64); its factorized algorithm is 3.8 times faster than MatX, and its polar format forms the image in 1.4 s on the L4 at -32 dB. Synthetic data is an important data source in the AI era.

Synthetic data is an important data source in the AI era. This paper studies the generation of mixed-type tabular synthetic data in federated settings, where two key challenges arise: ensuring distributional fidelity and effectively handling mixed-type data. We propose Federated Integrative Two-Step Synthesis (FITS), a framework for mixed-type tabular data synthesis. At its core is a two-step federated algorithm for estimating conditional cumulative distribution functions (CDFs) using local linear regression. Building on this algorithm, we develop a federated synthesis procedure based on the probability chain rule to ensure distributional fidelity. To handle mixed-type data, FITS introduces a continualization method that lifts discrete variables into a continuous space and recovers their discrete distributions without loss at both the density-function and CDF levels. This transformation provides a unified continuous representation of mixed-type variables, facilitating the application of local linear regression and synthetic data generation. item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

We study fully connected neural-network reconstruction by combining cryptanalytic weight-direction extraction with learning from predicted labels.

We study fully connected neural-network reconstruction by combining cryptanalytic weight-direction extraction with learning from predicted labels. We adapt a ReLU extraction implementation to Leaky ReLU, compare sign-search methods, and estimate biases and output layers. We prove conditional bounds for direction recovery with approximate prefixes, preservation of local distance votes, prediction changes from aligned parameter errors, and sign selection with independent scoring data. We also specify exact row restoration and distinguish its guarantee from that of gradient masking. The experiments evaluate assisted extraction, with privileged access to gradients, hidden activations, and victim parameters, followed by label-based reconstruction. Across eight search seeds on the largest synthetic architecture, Leaky ReLU recovers 51--57 neurons in the deepest hidden layer, while ReLU recovers none. This advantage does not hold uniformly across architectures and layers. Removing victim-weight access from the sign walk gives less accurate signs, despite high final prediction agreement. item.title: EnerGNN: Learning Optimization-Compatible Energy Functions for Exact Constrained Combinatorial Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Learning-based approaches to combinatorial optimization often predict solutions directly or use predictions to restrict search, while expressive energy-based...

Learning-based approaches to combinatorial optimization often predict solutions directly or use predictions to restrict search, while expressive energy-based models typically rely on approximate inference. We introduce EnerGNN, a framework that learns energy functions over complete binary configurations and minimizes them under explicit hard constraints through mixed integer programming (MIP). EnerGNN combines a graph neural network encoder with an optimization-compatible readout and a nonlinear energy head, enabling exact constrained inference over the learned energy. An optimality-aware contrastive loss trains the energy to reflect solution quality and constraint violations. Across Quadratic Knapsack, Combinatorial Auctions, and a personalized cell therapy supply chain problem, EnerGNN achieves near-optimal solutions with 100% feasibility. On the supply chain problem, it achieves a 0.05% mean primal gap and a 17.4$\times$ speedup over the monolithic MIP. The learned energy also generalizes to larger instances and supports zero-shot constraint injection, adapting to changing constraints without retraining while preserving feasibility.

item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Sustained attention is critical for academic performance, yet existing auditory support tools are static and not grounded in real-time neural evidence.

Sustained attention is critical for academic performance, yet existing auditory support tools are static and not grounded in real-time neural evidence. This paper presents EEGBiFormer, a hybrid CNN-Transformer model for realtime binary classification of attention states, focus versus nonfocus, from 16-channel EEG signals. A custom analog front-end acquisition board was designed and built to collect a task-based EEG dataset. Before model training, spectral and connectivity analysis, using Power Spectral Density and Phase Locking Value, confirmed distinct neural signatures between attention states, providing physiological grounding for the classification approach. EEGBiFormer achieved 91.3 percent window-level validation accuracy with an F1 score of 94.5 percent, and 88.2 percent recording-level accuracy across 17 independent sessions. End-to-end system latency was measured below 100 ms, supporting real-time responsiveness. The trained model was further used to objectively rank auditory stimuli by focus-state confidence, yielding EEG-informed audio protocols. item.title: DualPace: Decoupled Scheduling and Cooperative GPU--CPU Decoding for LLM Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM serving 中 KV 缓存随序列增长限制 GPU 并发，CPU 卸载可扩展容量但现有系统仍 GPU-gated，主机内存与 CPU 算力无法作为独立服务资源。

方法 DualPace 把主机变成独立调度的解码引擎：GPU 引擎执行 prefill 与 GPU 驻留解码，AMX 使能的 CPU 引擎独立批处理并推进 CPU 驻留解码；调度解耦、执行协作，CPU 可本地完成整轮解码迭代或选择性调用 GPU Dense Assist，离线 profile 指导硬件特定批处理与路由。

关键数字 解码场景吞吐较 NEO 提升 6.9-43.2%、较 vLLM 提升 11.5-90.6%，延迟同水平；保留 NEO 的 P99 TTFT 优势，同 P99 ITL 下请求率比 NEO 高 7.3-50.5%。

为什么值得看 把 CPU 侧变成真正独立解码资源的 serving 运行时，KV 卸载路线的重要升级。

item.title: DiffRouter: A Differentiable Routing Framework for UltraScale FPGAs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Routing has become a major bottleneck in large-scale FPGA design flows, where traditional routers rely on sequential net-by-net processing and rip-up-reroute...

Routing has become a major bottleneck in large-scale FPGA design flows, where traditional routers rely on sequential net-by-net processing and rip-up-reroute heuristics. This inherent sequentialism limits parallelism, leads to suboptimal utilization of routing resources, and significantly increases runtime on modern FPGAs. This paper introduces DiffRouter, the first differentiable, gradient-based FPGA routing framework with GPU acceleration. By lifting routing into a continuous optimization space, DiffRouter enables highly concurrent routing and improved global optimality before projecting solutions back onto the discrete fabric. The framework consists of three key stages: (1) Resource-pruned preprocessing, which extracts compact routing variables per net to reduce memory footprint and problem complexity; (2) Differentiable global routing via gradient descent, which formulates routing as a Lagrangian-relaxed optimization that minimizes wirelength while iteratively enforcing connectivity and congestion constraints as relaxed terms; and (3) Postprocessing, which maps the continuous wire distributions to a valid UltraScale routing solution and completes solutions by detailed routing. …

item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Symbolic regression (SR) seeks to discover mathematical expressions directly from data, without requiring task-specific scientific descriptions.

Symbolic regression (SR) seeks to discover mathematical expressions directly from data, without requiring task-specific scientific descriptions. Despite tremendous progress in both conventional search-based methods and recent LLM-based methods, two critical limitations largely remain. First (Limited Generation Flexibility), conventional search-based methods rely on either fixed search rules or specialized learned generators, severely limiting adaptive candidate generation across diverse expression structures. Second (Underutilized Search Discoveries), most LLM-based methods cannot reliably recover ground-truth expressions because they fall short in effectively leveraging the LLM itself to thoroughly digest past expressions or adaptively guide future search. To address these limitations, we propose DIGEST. To render greater flexibility in generation, DIGEST repurposes a pretrained decoder block from a lightweight LLM into a symbolic policy for Genetic Programming (GP) population seeding, thereby leveraging the broader modeling capacity of the LLM. To more thoroughly utilize search discoveries, high-quality expressions discovered by GP are fed back to update the LLM-derived policy on…

item.title: Counterfactual Test-Time Augmentation for Shortcut Removal in Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Large language models (LLMs) can exploit shortcuts, i.e., correlations present in training data that may not hold at test time.

Large language models (LLMs) can exploit shortcuts, i.e., correlations present in training data that may not hold at test time. This can lead to poor predictions when correlations shift. Most existing solutions for removing shortcuts operate at training time, requiring labeled training data, model weight access, and significant computational resources. Here, we study the problem of test-time shortcut removal. We propose a family of counterfactual test-time augmentation (CTTA) methods: given an example, each method uses an auxiliary model to generate counterfactual edits in which the shortcut value is changed, and then takes a weighted average of the LLM's predictions across these edits. We prove that the optimal shortcut-invariant predictor is a member of this CTTA family, and we characterize its weights. The weights depend on the training distribution, and therefore are, in general, not identifiable from the trained model and unlabeled test data. However, we present assumptions under which the weights can be obtained using the token probabilities of the trained LLM, and propose tests to detect violations of these assumptions. We use these tests to develop Select-CTTA, an aggregate…

Smart factories must translate order-level objectives into production tasks at multiple scales and combine the capabilities of individual units into an overa...

Smart factories must translate order-level objectives into production tasks at multiple scales and combine the capabilities of individual units into an overall delivery capability. To address repeated adaptation of organizational mechanisms across equipment, workshops, and factories, as well as coordination across levels under changing production conditions, this paper develops a framework for the collective collaboration of recursive autonomous agents (RAAs). A common task and capability interface supports the recursive decomposition of production objectives from the top down and the aggregation of conditional capabilities through peer collaboration from the bottom up. item.title: Clustering of High-Dimensional Human Gene Score Data for Target Cell Classification
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

The goal is to investigate whether the total human gene-score dataset and the selected human kinase-gene dataset exhibit the same number of clusters when ana...

The goal is to investigate whether the total human gene-score dataset and the selected human kinase-gene dataset exhibit the same number of clusters when analysed using the same set of 769 features. Two datasets were considered: the complete gene score dataset and a subset containing selected kinase genes. Two missing-data strategies were investigated. In Case I, rows containing missing gene-score values were removed. In Case II, rows with more than 20% missing values were excluded and the other missing values were replaced by the corresponding column mean. For each case, the data were scaled and principal component analysis (PCA) was performed before clustering. Four clustering approaches were considered: K-Means, Hierarchical Clustering, Fuzzy C-Means, and Graph-based Clustering. Across both datasets and both missing-data treatments, the optimal number of clusters was found to be two. In the absence of an optimal number of clusters, the quality of clustering was assessed using the Silhouette score. Relatively high Silhouette scores were obtained in all cases.

item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 MoE 稀疏激活使专家权重可驻留 CPU 内存按需传输，但模型稀疏度、CPU/GPU 吞吐、VRAM 与带宽差异会改变卸载策略排序；逐策略实现评估成本过高，如何低成本选优？

方法 COPE 在运行时集成前选出目标配置的最优卸载策略：Policy Matrix 把设计空间分解为专家驻留与 MoE 执行策略两个独立轴并暴露 4 个新候选；Virtual Heterogeneous Machine 刻画目标平台组合算子调度并结合离线路由迹估计性能。

关键数字 最优策略选择准确率提升 24%-100%，性能预测误差降 1.7x-6.8x；集成前定策使策略实现工作量最多降 74%。

为什么值得看 MoE 卸载策略的系统化选择框架，省掉逐策略工程实现成本。

Hyperbolic partial differential equations (PDEs) transport information at finite speed along characteristics, often producing shocks and discontinuities that...

Hyperbolic partial differential equations (PDEs) transport information at finite speed along characteristics, often producing shocks and discontinuities that are challenging to capture numerically. Graph neural networks (GNNs) offer learned update rules, but neighbor aggregation alone does not tell a GNN how far information must travel and along which edge. As a result, when a GNN model takes a time step larger than what was used in training, shock fronts smear and oscillations grow. In this work, we ask whether making the scale of transport explicit as an edge-local Courant-Friedrichs-Lewy (CFL) signal can enhance GNNs' ability to model hyperbolic PDEs. Holding the architecture fixed, we vary only the information given to each edge, from a raw edge form to forms that progressively expose the edge-local transport interaction through direction, length, and wave speed. Because all of these are computed from the same ingredients, what changes is not the amount of information but its form. The results show a consistent pattern, in which feature count is not the limiting factor, and appending CFL directly to a raw edge form produces almost no benefit. The CFL conditioning proves most ef…

item.title: Beyond Affine Reconstruction: Multi-Resolution Transformer DeepONets for the Radiative Transfer Equation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

Radiative heat transfer plays a dominant role in fire simulations, where solving the radiative transfer equation (RTE) is a computational bottleneck.

Radiative heat transfer plays a dominant role in fire simulations, where solving the radiative transfer equation (RTE) is a computational bottleneck. Neural operators can accelerate these computations by learning solution operators from offline simulation data. However, conventional DeepONet surrogates rely on fixed-grid inputs and affine reconstruction, limiting their flexibility across resolutions and their approximation accuracy at a fixed latent dimension. In this paper, we develop a transformer-based DeepONet for multi-resolution RTE surrogate modelling. The proposed approach combines a Perceiver encoder, which maps temperature and absorption coefficient fields at different spatial resolutions into a fixed-size latent representation, with a cross-attention decoder that enables non-affine reconstruction of the radiative intensity. This architecture allows a single model to process inputs at varying resolutions without resampling them onto a common grid. We formulate a computable empirical version of a previously derived theoretical lower bound for affine reconstruction, enabling direct comparison with model errors on the same dataset. item.title: An Empirical Study of Reinforcement Learning Scaling Laws
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

The discovery of scaling laws enables prediction of the performance, the optimal resource allocation strategy, and the best hyperparameter configuration of a...

The discovery of scaling laws enables prediction of the performance, the optimal resource allocation strategy, and the best hyperparameter configuration of a large-scale training job based on inexpensive experiments at smaller scales. Guided by these empirical scaling laws, the deep learning community has achieved great success in training large (self-)supervised models on Internet-scale datasets. In contrast, despite its potential and wide application, reinforcement learning (RL) has yet to find a guiding principle for predictable scaling. In this work, we conduct an empirical study of RL scaling laws of an actor-critic algorithm in two procedurally generated environments, Starpilot and Craftax. We discover empirical scaling laws with strong predictive performance in both environments. The discovered scaling laws accurately predict the aforementioned three quantities for larger-scale training jobs up to two orders of magnitude in total training compute. In particular, we employ a variant of Elo scores for the single-agent RL paradigm as an alternative performance metric than the commonly used mean episode return. Our results show that the Elo score is a much more predictable metri…

item.title: Adapting DNNs to Embrace Voltage Scaling Induced Errors via Accumulation-Aware Quantization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 电压缩放是强力的降功耗手段，但新一代工艺节点上吞吐退化严重且易受工艺变化影响，DNN 的能效-可靠性如何兼得？

方法 软硬件协同：累积感知训练把累加器时序鲁棒位区间作为一阶优化约束，混合精度量化+非结构化剪枝约束权重分布避开硬件敏感的高秩进位链；架构侧做选择性 MSB 掩蔽与细粒度门控时钟，并逐层动态频率缩放适配累加器动态范围。

关键数字 深度缩放的 2nm 节点低电压前沿下，协同优化 post-layout 架构较标称电压实现能耗降 39%、能量延迟积降 23%，精度退化在 1% 以内。

为什么值得看 面向电压缩放容错的完整软硬件协同方案，低功耗 DNN 能效收益量化清晰。

item.title: A Distribution-Matching Perspective on LLM Training Algorithms
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-24　分类：论文PDF

In this work, we propose a unified framework for training algorithms across different stages of modern large language model development, based on the perspec...

In this work, we propose a unified framework for training algorithms across different stages of modern large language model development, based on the perspective of distribution matching. We show that a broad class of language model training algorithms can be interpreted as minimizing a certain divergence between the current model and a target distribution, and that characterizing the properties of this target distribution provides substantial insight into the behavior of the corresponding training algorithms. By analyzing specific forms of the target distribution, we establish that On-Policy Distillation (OPD) enjoys an advantage over classical Knowledge Distillation (KD) when the current model distribution is close to the target distribution, while exhibiting a disadvantage when the two distributions are far apart. Furthermore, when the target distribution itself depends on the model being optimized, we show that the accumulation of estimation variance can induce a deterministic degradation of the target distribution. These results provide a theoretical explanation, at least in part, for the long-term behavior of existing Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms. With this intuitio…

item.title: vLLM Delivers Day-0 Support for MiniMax-M3.1-Flash
item.description:
发表方：vLLM Blog　发布：2026-10-23　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题 vLLM 对 MiniMax-M3.1-Flash 的 Day-0 支持。

要点 M3.1-Flash 原生 NVFP4 KV cache、NVFP4 量化 MoE 权重、DSpark draft 模型做推测解码；Blackwell 上用 CUDA 13.4 QMUL4 指令在 kernel 内把 NVFP4 反量化为 FP8；Rubin（SM107）与 AMD MI350 各有专用 kernel；提供 Day-0 RL 支持（veRL、FSDP2、LoRA）。

关键数字 indexer QK decode 最高快 1.7×、稀疏注意力 decode 快 1.3×；prefill 吞吐高 7%；512K 上下文 4×GB300 上 indexer 每稀疏层快 3.3×；GB300 上最高 418.9 tok/s/用户，Rubin 上 724.9 tok/s/用户、191.5K 总 tok/s/GPU。

为什么值得看 NVFP4 原生推理栈在三大 GPU 平台的落地实测，推测解码+稀疏注意力组合的工程标杆。

item.title: Where Rounding Happens Matters: Rounding-Location Alignment Stabilizes LLM Reinforcement Learning
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM 强化学习常用独立推理与训练系统，即便权重与 BF16 张量一致，实现差异也会使本应在策略的更新偏离策略、训练不稳定——能否只对齐部分执行栈就稳定 BF16 RL？

方法 把训练侧舍入位置与推理对齐三个区域：RoPE、SwiGLU 与残差 RMSNorm，方法是在其 BF16 输出前将选定中间量保留为 FP32；推理引擎、矩阵乘/注意力 kernel 与学习目标均保持不变。

关键数字 在四个 Qwen 系列模型上，对齐全部三个区域防止了默认 BF16 基线下的训练崩溃；单对齐 RoPE 路径在实验中也已足够，尽管仍有数值差异残留。

为什么值得看 "舍入位置对齐"而非全局精度升级来稳定 BF16 RL，代价极小，RL 训练工程可直接采用。

item.title: When Does Dynamics Randomization Test Context Inference?
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Environments with randomized dynamics are widely used to ask whether world models need explicit context inference. However, randomization can leave little predictive information fo...

Environments with randomized dynamics are widely used to ask whether world models need explicit context inference. However, randomization can leave little predictive information for a context encoder to add, because distinct latent parameters may produce similar transitions at visited states, or those states may already reveal the active context. We formalize the remaining one-step information as predictive headroom and compare kernels under fixed and visited state--action distributions to distinguish changes in query coverage from changes in context weights. We analyze discrete and continuous environments and find low headroom both when kernels differ little and when visitation reduces an otherwise large discrepancy. At the same time, resetting state components increases headroom, showing that context evidence accumulates in state. We propose reporting this headroom alongside the randomized parameters, so that gains from explicit context inference can be interpreted relative to the information missing from the current state and action.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Vision Token Pruning via Query-Vision Interaction Decomposition
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 VLM 视觉 token 数量大导致推理成本高，现有基于 query 的剪枝多用注意力/动态启发式，未显式利用 query-vision 交互的底层结构。

方法 观察到 transformer attention 中 query/key 投影自然诱导的交互矩阵近似低秩、少数主导潜在模式承载 query 相关语义；据此提出 QViD，免训练的 query 感知视觉 token 剪枝方法。

关键数字 摘要未给出具体数值；图像与视频理解基准上、匹配 token 预算下持续提升性能，且在激进压缩区间增益最大。

为什么值得看 把低秩结构洞察直接变成免训练剪枝，VLM 推理成本优化的即插即用思路。

item.title: TranSAGE: Automating Spatial Accelerator Generation for Large-Scale Transformer Models
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 大规模 Transformer 推理的计算与内存需求高，空间加速器在片上带宽与能效上有优势，但为大型模型设计加速器昂贵耗时；现有生成器通常只支持单算子，忽略多算子流水线收益。

方法 提出 TranSAGE，基于编译器的框架：在多算子流水线调度下联合优化大型 Transformer，并自动生成加速器实现；集成设计空间探索引擎、多算子数据流优化与基于动态规划的图划分算法，找出适合流水线的算子簇与最优数据流参数；提供空间架构原语与 lowering pass 自动生成 RTL 实现。

关键数字 摘要未给出具体性能数值；核心贡献是多算子流水线联合优化的自动加速器生成。

为什么值得看 编译器驱动+多算子流水线的 Transformer 空间加速器自动生成，芯片设计自动化方向可参考。

item.title: Toward Open ISA Supercomputing: A Comparative Study of RISC-V, Arm, and x86 Architectures on HPC Workloads
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 RISC-V 能否挑战 HPC 领域成熟的 x86 与 Arm？现有研究平台、负载与方法各异、罕有考虑能效，难以公平对比。

方法 用统一软件栈与方法论对比当代 HPC RISC-V、Arm 与 x86 处理器：刻画 Sophgo SG2044，与 NVIDIA Grace CPU Superchip、Intel Xeon Platinum 8480+ 在四个 HPC 基准（STREAM、HPL、HPL-MxP、HPCG）与四个代表应用（iPIC3D、PLUTO、OpenFOAM、llama.cpp）上对比；所用 OpenBLAS 版 HPL-MxP 以开源形式发布。

关键数字 SG2044 单核 FP64 8.02 GFLOP/s、内存带宽 7.8 GB/s，64 核时升至 294 GFLOP/s 与 107 GB/s；L2 缓存感知的进程放置使扩展到 16 核近线性，其后受内存带宽饱和限制。

为什么值得看 统一方法下的 RISC-V/Arm/x86 HPC 能效横评，开放指令集超算路线的重要数据点。
item.content:encoded:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 RISC-V 能否挑战 HPC 领域成熟的 x86 与 Arm？现有研究平台、负载与方法各异、罕有考虑能效，难以公平对比。

方法 用统一软件栈与方法论对比当代 HPC RISC-V、Arm 与 x86 处理器：刻画 Sophgo SG2044，与 NVIDIA Grace CPU Superchip、Intel Xeon Platinum 8480+ 在四个 HPC 基准（STREAM、HPL、HPL-MxP、HPCG）与四个代表应用（iPIC3D、PLUTO、OpenFOAM、llama.cpp）上对比；所用 OpenBLAS 版 HPL-MxP 以开源形式发布。

关键数字 SG2044 单核 FP64 8.02 GFLOP/s、内存带宽 7.8 GB/s，64 核时升至 294 GFLOP/s 与 107 GB/s；L2 缓存感知的进程放置使扩展到 16 核近线性，其后受内存带宽饱和限制。

为什么值得看 统一方法下的 RISC-V/Arm/x86 HPC 能效横评，开放指令集超算路线的重要数据点。

item.title: The Clustering Occupation Kernel (CLOCK) Method for Time Series Arising from Dynamical Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

We introduce the Clustering Occupation Kernel (CLOCK) method, a novel representation-based framework for clustering time series arising from dynamical systems.

We introduce the Clustering Occupation Kernel (CLOCK) method, a novel representation-based framework for clustering time series arising from dynamical systems. CLOCK embeds observed sequences into a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) via a time-averaged occupation kernel, enabling trajectory comparison through their RKHS norm. For systems governed by differential equations, this formulation rigorously approximates the kernel mean embedding of the invariant Sinai-Ruelle-Bowen (SRB) measure, meaning our dissimilarity metric approximates the maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) between attractors. To accommodate general time series, we introduce time lags via Takens' Embedding Theorem to reconstruct the phase space. Crucially, CLOCK natively handles trajectories of unequal lengths and irregularly-spaced observations. We validate the proposed metric using spectral clustering, demonstrating superior performance against benchmark methods on both synthetic datasets and a real-world intracranial large-scale electroencephalogram (EEG) dataset. Finally, ablation studies on the Lorenz-96 system are consistent with the theoretical convergence rates of the occupation kernels and highlight the me…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Sustainability of TSFM Deployment and Pretraining: From Carbon Footprint Analysis to Mitigation via Pruning
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 时序基础模型（TSFM）零样本预测强但预训练成本高——相比需周期性重训的监督单模型，前置投入在全生命周期内是否划算？

方法 建模不同方案在现实工业场景中的累计碳排放：对比 Chronos-2 与经典监督模型的部署生命周期碳成本；针对需要降低 TSFM 自身成本的情形，用无梯度剪枝准则移除单个编码器块，评估其对 FLOPs、CO2、延迟与零样本性能的影响。

关键数字 移除单编码器块（7.9% 参数）带来一致的 6–9% FLOPs/CO2/延迟下降，25 任务基准上零样本预测性能基本无损；大型或高频查询部署中 Chronos-2 数月内摊薄预训练成本，小型或低频场景经典模型长期更便宜。

为什么值得看 从全生命周期碳成本看 TSFM 值不值得用，可持续 AI 的成本核算样例。

item.title: Sparsity-driven emergence of functional modularity in multitask neural networks
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Neural networks can learn multiple tasks, but how learning organizes shared computation into specialized and reusable components remains poorly understood. In this work, we show th...

Neural networks can learn multiple tasks, but how learning organizes shared computation into specialized and reusable components remains poorly understood. In this work, we show that sparsity inducing regularization promotes functional modularity in multitask networks without predefined module boundaries. Using functional profiling in multilayer perceptrons and a lightweight transformer, we identified compact, task-selective subnetworks, termed functional tokens. Across rule-based task families, selectively retaining these tokens preserves their associated functions while reducing performance on other tasks. Such specialization develops preferentially in deeper layers during training, while earlier layers retain shared computation. Regularization strength and form shape module compactness and specialization, while task weighting alters functional allocation. Moreover, extracted functional tokens can be recombined through alternative pathways to reconstruct a learned composite computation without retraining, preserving their connectivity and learned weights. Our results suggest that sparsity-constrained optimization shapes not only parameter use but also the organization and reuse o…

核心话题 vLLM 用通用引擎在 GB300 NVL72 整机架上大规模服务 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash，与 DeepSeek 自家引擎 DeepInfer 对标。

要点 P/D disaggregation（prefill/decode 分离）+ Wide-EP 扩展；prefill 用小 DEP 实例、decode 用 Wide-EP + EPLB；指出 CPU 开销在 NVL72 规模成为关键；专用 decode 路径压低单用户延迟；通用引擎匹配模型专用引擎的关键是对模型结构（MoE 稀疏性、nextn）的理解与基于 DeepSeek 开源 kernel 的工程化。

关键数字 SemiAnalysis AgentX 上 954K tokens/s/GPU，用户 P90 196 tokens/s，是首篇单节点结果的 7.9×；DeepSeek 非高峰电价下 $38.96/GPU-hour；单用户专用 decode 路径 826 tokens/s；与 DeepInfer 对比，batch 8–256 下 decode 吞吐差在 6% 以内。

为什么值得看 旗舰 MoE 模型上开源推理栈与官方引擎正面交锋的数据点，规模化推理选型可参考。

item.title: Searching with Sparse Histories: Cross-Task Architecture Search from Incomplete Search Logs and Zero-Cost Proxies
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Neural architecture search (NAS) is expensive, but cross-task transfer can reduce costs by reusing knowledge from previous tasks. However, existing methods struggle with sparse sea...

Neural architecture search (NAS) is expensive, but cross-task transfer can reduce costs by reusing knowledge from previous tasks. However, existing methods struggle with sparse search histories and task-specific transfer failures. We propose a method, a risk-robust strategy that combines sparse source logs with zero-cost proxies through champion-based initialization and joint pairwise-ranker pretraining. On TransNAS-Bench-101, the proposal mitigates severe worst-case failures, reducing worst-10% ranks from 290 to 43 for Micro autoencoding and from 465 to 45 for Macro room layout. Across 13 cell-space targets, it outperforms a proxy-only ranker on 10 targets in both mean and worst-case performance, while maintaining competitive average performance.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: RobustRLlib: A Unified Library and Benchmark for Robust Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Robust reinforcement learning (RL) is critical for reliable real-world deployment, where policies may fail under diverse shifts and disruptions. Existing robust RL algorithms offer...

Robust reinforcement learning (RL) is critical for reliable real-world deployment, where policies may fail under diverse shifts and disruptions. Existing robust RL algorithms offer a rich set of mechanisms and principles, yet two major barriers limit their broader potential: limited algorithm reusability and an unclear empirical capability boundary. We introduce RobustRLlib, an algorithm-centric library and benchmark that addresses both challenges. It integrates 17 representative robust online, offline, and safe RL algorithms under a unified interface for substantially improved reusability, together with an enhanced evaluation platform spanning diverse real-world shifts and advanced humanoid and vision-language-action tasks. Systematic evaluation over 273 perturbation configurations provides an up-to-date capability map of current robust RL algorithms, revealing where they remain effective and where substantial robustness gaps persist. As an open-source, user-friendly platform, RobustRLlib offers a reproducible and extensible codebase for applying existing methods to new problems and developing new robust RL algorithms.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Rethinking LoRA Initialization for Robust Asymmetric Learning Rates
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is often highly sensitive to learning-rate (LR) choices. Recent empirical studies suggest that, once LRs are carefully tuned, vanilla LoRA can remain com...

Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is often highly sensitive to learning-rate (LR) choices. Recent empirical studies suggest that, once LRs are carefully tuned, vanilla LoRA can remain competitive with many proposed LoRA variants. This shifts the central practical question from designing ever more variants to reducing the cost and brittleness of LR selection. LoRA+ addresses this issue with asymmetric LRs, using a larger LR for the up-projection matrix $B$ than for the down-projection matrix $A$. However, the ratio $η_B / η_A$ itself becomes an additional hyperparameter: large ratios can improve adaptation, but under the standard LoRA initialization they can also cause unstable training and ratio-dependent performance collapse. We identify the source of this brittleness through a signal--noise decomposition of LoRA dynamics. Under standard \initA, the update contains an initialization-induced noise term whose magnitude can be affected by the LR for $B$, $η_B$, the initialization scale $β$, and the adapter rank $r$. In practical LLM fine-tuning, this non-vanishing noise can limit the performance gains expected from LoRA+ style asymmetric LRs. To suppress this effect, we propose \initAA, a s…

Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is often highly sensitive to learning-rate (LR) choices. Recent empirical studies suggest that, once LRs are carefully tuned, vanilla LoRA can remain competitive with many proposed LoRA variants. This shifts the central practical question from designing ever more variants to reducing the cost and brittleness of LR selection. LoRA+ addresses this issue with asymmetric LRs, using a larger LR for the up-projection matrix $B$ than for the down-projection matrix $A$. However, the ratio $η_B / η_A$ itself becomes an additional hyperparameter: large ratios can improve adaptation, but under the standard LoRA initialization they can also cause unstable training and ratio-dependent performance collapse. We identify the source of this brittleness through a signal--noise decomposition of LoRA dynamics. Under standard \initA, the update contains an initialization-induced noise term whose magnitude can be affected by the LR for $B$, $η_B$, the initialization scale $β$, and the adapter rank $r$. In practical LLM fine-tuning, this non-vanishing noise can limit the performance gains expected from LoRA+ style asymmetric LRs. To suppress this effect, we propose \initAA, a s…

item.title: Reinforcement Learning with Multi-Step Transition Predictions: A Bellman Theory
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Multi-step predictions of future transition realizations can improve reinforcement learning, but their value remains difficult to quantify. Directly including these predictions in ...

Multi-step predictions of future transition realizations can improve reinforcement learning, but their value remains difficult to quantify. Directly including these predictions in the state can lead to exponential state-space growth, making direct dynamic programming computationally expensive. We study discounted finite MDPs under a block-feedback protocol: at the start of each K-period block, the decision maker observes $K$-step probabilistic transition predictions for a subset of actions and adapts decisions to observed states within the block. We show that the optimal value satisfies a Bayesian Bellman equation on the original state space. This representation reveals that predictive information creates value by recursively changing the local order of maximization and expectation in the Bellman expansion. We formalize this effect through a Bellman--Jensen analysis and quantify the effects of prediction horizon, error, action coverage, and within-block feedback. We propose block-feedback Bayesian offline learning with online adaptation (BF--BOLA), a model-based algorithm for learning near-optimal policies, and establish upper and lower sample-complexity bounds that match up to log…

item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

In drug development, lead optimization must improve competing properties, such as increasing permeability and reducing toxicity, while limiting scaffold changes that could compromi...

In drug development, lead optimization must improve competing properties, such as increasing permeability and reducing toxicity, while limiting scaffold changes that could compromise the lead's potency. RL-based post-training, such as C-MORAL, addresses this problem by fine-tuning molecular language models to directly optimize molecular leads for objectives of interest, which relies on expensive task-specific datasets and faces challenges in achieving multi-objective optimization (MOO). We argue a pre-trained model may already contain useful molecular edits that zero-shot generation cannot efficiently reach. Motivated by the limited search capabilities of zero-shot generation, we develop an efficient Metropolis-Hastings search strategy to better explore the proposal distribution. We propose ReMedI, which uses the molecular language model as a base proposer for inference-time alignment. Given a lead and a set of multi-objective tasks, the model proposes edits conditioned on the current molecule, while Metropolis--Hastings refinement guides sequential edits under an objective for property improvement, preservation, and lead similarity. Classical optimization and learning-guided search offer complementary approaches to open problems in discrete mathematics, but their outputs are difficult to compare when search spaces, validity checks, and stopping rules differ. We present \emph{RadonBench}, a benchmark for constructing maximum-cardinality Radon-free lattice configurations: finite subsets of $\mathbb{Z}^d$ admitting no integral Radon partition. It remains open whether Radon-free configurations with $11$ points in $\mathbb{Z}^3$ or $21$ points in $\mathbb{Z}^4$ are possible. If they exist, they would improve the corresponding lower bounds on the integer Radon numbers. We compare exhaustive extension, greedy local search, PatternBoost, AlphaZero, and AlphaEvolve. All outputs use one success predicate: a convex target-sized configuration succeeds exactly when its number of integral Radon points is zero. item.title: Quantum Cadence: Post-Quantum Consensus with Multiple Concurrent Proposers
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

The consensus protocols of most high-performance blockchains use quorum certificates, which bundle the signatures of a quorum of validators. Signature schemes such as BLS can aggre...

The consensus protocols of most high-performance blockchains use quorum certificates, which bundle the signatures of a quorum of validators. Signature schemes such as BLS can aggregate the signatures of a whole quorum into a single short signature, which keeps these certificates small. A large-scale quantum computer would break these schemes, and no post-quantum scheme with comparable aggregate size and aggregation time is known. Without aggregation, a certificate holds one large post-quantum signature per member of the quorum, so it becomes infeasible for each validator to broadcast certificates, as modern consensus protocols often require. We present Quantum Cadence, a post-quantum consensus protocol with multiple concurrent proposers that avoids certificates altogether: every validator counts quorums among the messages it has received itself. Its safety and liveness do not even depend on signatures, although we add signatures to obtain accountability. Quantum Cadence builds on Cadence and replaces its slot consensus, Chorus, with Quantum Chorus, which keeps the optimal fast-path latency of Chorus: dissemination followed by two rounds of votes. When its fast path fails, Quantum C…

item.title: Putting Transformer Theories to the Test
item.description:
发表方：（未标注）　发布：2026-10-23　分类：论文PDF

Several formal theories have been developed to characterize the capabilities and limitations of the transformer architecture, each employing different abstractions that capture dif...

Several formal theories have been developed to characterize the capabilities and limitations of the transformer architecture, each employing different abstractions that capture different features of the architecture. Due to the differences in their underlying assumptions and conceptual frameworks, these theories can disagree in their predictions about what tasks transformers find easy or hard. We map out seven theories of transformer capability (Star-free, $\mathsf{AC}^0$, $\mathsf{TC}^0$, C-RASP, MPC, BAPO, and Sensitivity) and translate their results into a common matrix of predictions across a suite of tasks covering different computational structures. We provide new theoretical results to complete this matrix. We then evaluate theoretical predictions through controlled experiments measuring in-distribution sample complexity, length generalization, and pretrained language model performance. We find that no single theory explains the observed pattern of successes and failures.
